name: Frasca Food and Wine
description: Located steps from Pearl Street Mall, Frasca Food and Wine is a Michelin-Starred, James Beard Award–Winning restaurant celebrating the cuisine and hospitality of Friuli-Venezia Giulia, Italy. Founded by Master Sommelier Bobby Stuckey and Chef Lachlan Mackinnon-Patterson, and led by Chef Ian Palazzola, Frasca brings refined Italian dining to downtown Boulder.Enjoy signature dishes like the beloved Frico Caldo, the immersive Chef’s Table, or the Friulano Tasting Menu, paired with wines from an award-winning list spanning Friuli’s native grapes to world-renowned cult labels.With elegant interiors, warm service, and a legacy of excellence—including a Michelin One Star and the 2025 James Beard Award for Outstanding Restaurant—Frasca offers one of Colorado’s most exceptional dining experiences. Perfect for special occasions, fine wine dinners, or romantic evenings in Boulder.Gift cards available at frascafoodandwine.com.

name: Four by Brother Luck
description: At Four, the rugged peaks of Colorado meet the sun-soaked deserts of the Southwest: regional cooking through the four seasons. Founded by chef-owner Brother Luck and led in the kitchen by Executive Chef Ashley Brown, the menu changes each season to follow what the Four Corners region grows, raises, and forages — from wild game and river fish to farm harvests and foraged finds. Choose a rotating four-course tasting or order à la carte, with craft cocktails, local beer, and a curated wine list. The room is casual and elegant; the cooking is serious. Chef-owner Brother Luck is a James Beard Semifinalist for Best Chef: Mountain, a Top Chef and Beat Bobby Flay alum, and author of No Lucks Given.We offer happy hour Tuesday - Sunday from 3pm-5pm, with discounted drinks and bar appetizers. Dinner service begins at 5pm Tuesday - Sunday.Vegan 4-course Menu Offered in addition to regular menu

name: Bar Pigalle
description: Bar Pigalle, located at 2915 John R Street in the heart of Brush Park, Detroit, offers a New-American, French-inspired dining experience combined with a creative selection of playful cocktails and an exceptional wine list. Led by award-winning mixologist Travis Fourmont and Chef Norman Valenti, Bar Pigalle is nestled within The Carlton Lofts, a historic building designed by renowned American architect Louis Kamper.

name: BARDA
description: Inspired by the parrillas of his native Argentina and the hip enclaves of contemporary Buenos Aires, Chef Javier Bardauil brings the art of live-fire cooking to Detroit at BARDA — a modern steakhouse where ancestral traditions meet out-of-this-world innovation. The BARDA kitchen relies solely on a wood-burning grill and oven, ensuring that every dish is either flame-cooked, fire-kissed, or served raw, showcasing premium cuts of meat and high-quality seafood and vegetables prepared to highlight their natural flavors. The thoughtfully curated South American wine list and playful cocktail menu provide artful balance to the fire-infused cuisine. Recognized as a James Beard Award finalist for Best New Restaurant in 2022, Barda invites you to experience the depth and warmth that only live-fire cooking can offer, in a futuristic space unlike any other restaurant in America.

name: Ladder 4 Wine Bar
description: Our menu changes with the seasons, and what we think looks good right now. We start with whatever we harvested from our garden this morning, or with whatever our farmers dropped off today. We're building relationships with the people who grow our food and make our wine - people who care as much about their craft as we do about ours.  We take our wine and our food seriously. Everything else? It’s just dinner with friends.Since opening in 2022, we've been recognized as the Detroit Free Press Restaurant of the Year in 2023, one of Bon Appetit's Best New Restaurants of 2023 and in America's Best Restaurants of 2023 list by the New York Times.Reservations are for dinner service. If you're joining us for drinks, please walk in for bar seats. Our bar is always kept available for walk-ins, for full dinner service, or just drinks. We ask that your entire party arrive on time. If you are more than 15 minutes late for your reservation, we may release it to a waiting party.

name: The Pig and the Lady
description: From it’s humble beginnings as a pop-up restaurant, to a farmer"s market stand and now a successful brick-and-mortar eatery, The Pig and the Lady, led by twice-nominated James Beard semifinalist Chef Andrew Le (with help from his family including his mother, Mama Le), cook up what is essentially the family meal in the truest sense --  Exposing Honolulu diners a cross-section of cuisine that has Vietnamese origins, but is eclectic and daring.Chef Le and his team have developed a modern, fresh take on traditional Southeast Asian food, utilizing local products -- serving their famous banh mi and pho, along with new favorites. Le is the one of the few chefs cooking contemporary food built on Southeast Asian flavors that has garnered rave reviews -- a foundation built on delicious memories first introduced by his mother. They are open Monday through Saturday, serving lunch and dinner. You can also still find them at the Farmer’s Markets at Blaisdell, Kailua and KCC.

name: Senia
description: Senia is one of Honolulu’s favorite restaurants for simply good food. We offer an à la carte menu with delicious, casual food made with exceptional craft. Chef Anthony Rush trained in multiple three Michelin-starred restaurants and creates beautiful dishes with passion and skill, but he believes everyday food should be delicious and well-crafted, too, so Senia was created to be a casual, affordable, neighborhood restaurant. We celebrate quality ingredients, creativity, classic techniques, and thoughtful hospitality. We welcome you in for dinner to share a meal with friends and loved ones in a comfortable, beautiful space. If you are looking for a fine dining experience, we invite you to join us at our Chefs’ Counter for our award-winning Tasting Menu. With eight seats and one seating on Friday and Saturday nights, our Tasting Menu is exclusive and luxurious. It’s not all fancy on the weekends, though. We always offer casual dining and our à la carte menu in our main dining room.

name: MW Restaurant
description: Discover the vibrant flavors of Hawaii at MW Restaurant, where renowned chefs Wade Ueoka and Michelle Karr-Ueoka showcase their passion for local cuisine. Now on the 2nd floor of the Velocity Honolulu Building, our new location offers a refined yet casual dining experience that celebrates Hawaii’s rich culinary heritage.Conveniently located across from the Blaisdell Center, use “Velocity Honolulu” or “888 Kapiolani Blvd” for accurate directions. Valet parking is available at the entrance from Kapiolani Blvd up the ramp; avoid parking in the MW Valet-only stall on the ground level as it is subject to towing.Join us to savor exquisite regional dishes and delectable desserts that have made MW Restaurant a cornerstone of Hawaii’s culinary scene. Visit https://mwrestaurant.com/ to place your order or learn more.

name: MĀZE
description: MĀZE is an "omakase" dining/cocktail concept by Justin and Tom Park, the duo behind award winning cocktail bar, Bar Leather Apron, MĀZE offers an innovative, integrated culinary and cocktail experience. 2024/2025 James Beard Award Nominee, Head Chef Ki Chung and 2023 James Beard Award Winner, Head Bartender Justin Park work collaboratively to craft an omakase dinner course (seasonal tasting menu with cocktail or non-alcoholic pairings) in which food and drink are conceived as intertwined creations.We offer two choices for dinner service: Our signature omakase experience featuring a seasonal tasting menu with cocktail or non-alcoholic pairings for $200/guest and a basic seasonal tasting menu for $125/guest with a side menu of optional add-ons. You will be asked to make your choice when seated.We do not have a child or a la carte menu. Young diners are required to partake in our normal course offering.We do not offer a vegetarian, vegan, or gluten-free menu.

name: Lineage Maui
description: Nestled in the Shops of Wailea offering a true "foodie" experience, Lineage delights guests from around the globe and locals alike. Reservation phone line opens at 2pm daily (808)879-8800.  Please include in your guest count: infants, toddlers and children.While we do our best to accommodate special requests, we cannot make any guarantees.  Maximum of 2 split checks per reservation.15-minute late grace period from reservation time, if you are more than 15 minutes late, your reservation will be cancelled.Credit card is required to hold reservations of 7 or more.Cancellation Policy: $25 pp fee for cancellation or decrease in guest count within 24 hrs of reservation.Walk-ins: We welcome walk-ins if and when tables are availableOpen Tuesday through Saturday from 5 PM to 9 PM.  Closed Sunday & Mondays.  Mahalo!

name: Rosie Cannonball
description: *Starting Tuesday, July 7, Rosie Cannonball will be open until 10:30pm. Our Reverse Happy Hour will take place nightly from 9:30-10:30pm, now featuring half-off pizza and wine.*At Rosie Cannonball, we’re serving European comfort food in a lively atmosphere. The restaurant celebrates the origins of cooking through open, live fire and is centered around a wood-burning oven and grill.The menu draws inspiration from individual ingredients: local vegetables, pastas and pizzas, simple seafood and locally-sourced meat cooked over live fire.Master Sommelier June Rodil curated an expansive list of delicious wines with a strong Italian, Spanish and French focus from their favorite producers new and old, along with options from progressive New World producers.  The cocktail menu has strong Italian influences, mirroring the focus of the food.Chef de Cuisine: Melven BatocabeGeneral Manager: Ricardo FloresGoodnight Hospitality Partners: Bailey & Peter McCarthy, Felipe Riccio, June Rodil

name: BCN Taste & Tradition
description: BCN Taste & Tradition, the name gives a nod to Barcelona and the meld of traditional and modern Spanish cuisine. Chef Luis Roger relocated from Girona, Spain - trained under Michelin Chef Ferran Adria at elBulli- and taught at the renowned culinary school Aula Gastronomica de l’Emporada. Located on a 1920’s era Victorian home in the trendy Montrose/Museum District (4210 Roseland St.). BCN Taste & Tradition will recreate an authentic Spanish style dining experience with unparalleled service. The menu showcases all the fantastic, cutting-edge haute cuisine that put Spain on the world stage. Credit card info required for reservations larger than 5 guests.  A $50/person fee will be charged if you are unable to cancel within 48 of your scheduled time or if your party decreases in size within 24 of your reservation. No fee will be assessed for transferring the reservation to a different name.

name: Maximo
description: Nestled in the heart of Houston’s West University neighborhood at 6119 Edloe Street, Maximo is a progressive Mexican restaurant from the Local Foods Group team that combines authenticity and adventure. Nearly everything is done in house under Executive Chef Adrian Torres with mentorship from Local Foods Group Creative & Culinary Director Seth Siegel-Gardner. Nixtamalized tortillas are just the start; corn kernels are boiled, soaked and ground into masa, imparting maximum flavor into a dedicated masa section on the menu featuring sopes, tetelas and even cornbread, along with a list of ever-changing taco options. Shareable plates, from crudos and salads to entrees and desserts, entice guests to explore. The restaurant is open Wednesday through Friday from 4 - 9 p.m. for dinner service, Saturday and Sunday from 11 a.m. - 3 p.m. for brunch and 5 - 9 p.m. for dinner service.

name: ChopnBlok
description: Created by 2024 James Beard Emerging Chef Nominee, Ope Amosu, ChòpnBlọk is a nationally acclaimed restaurant that carefully unveils the West African culinary experience, serving fresh proteins, vegetables, grains, and beverages that are prepared under a West African flavor profile, packaged in a local, contemporary fashion.Freshness and integrity are embedded in our culture. We selectively source our ingredients and work with partners to procure natural, high-quality meats and vegetables.At its core, ChòpnBlọk is the cultural crossroads where local communities and West African culinary traditions intersect, to deliver a convenient, hospitable food experience with exquisite taste.

name: Musaafer - Houston
description: Musaafer, meaning traveller, is a dining experience set in opulent space showcasing the art and architecture of India.  Chef was sent on an ambitious task of traveling all the states of India; gathering stories and experiences along the way and bringing home age-old regional recipes, which have been translated into our eclectic menu, making the journey an integral part of our menu and regional offerings. You’ll find Musaafer in Houston in the Galleria shopping complex, close to the city’s lively business district. The elegant two-story space with sweeping windows offers a luxurious and memorable dining experience. Guests are treated to unforgettable Indian cuisine, a world-class wine program and unparalleled hospitality.

name: Bludorn
description: Nestled in the heart of Montrose Chef Aaron Bludorn roots himself in the Gulf serving New American, French-inspired fare with passion and integrity. The menus are comprised of seasonally rotating dishes, global wines, and handcrafted cocktails served in this neighborhood landmark.

name: Agnes and Sherman
description: Named after chef's parents, Agnes and Sherman is a diner experience all about Asian American comfort food. Co-Owners Lisa Lee and Nick Wong's cozy new restaurant in the vibrant Houston Heights honor their unique third-culture Asian American roots, and everything that’s special about Houston. Inventive versions of familiar flavors are nestled alongside the golden rules of inclusion and belonging, as it’s now more important than ever to convey the values that have always been true: taking care of others is an act of love, and everyone is welcome here.We hold tables up to 15 min and we kindly ask for complete parties before seating. After 15 min we'll do our best to seat you but your reservation is not guaranteed. To honor your seating time, placing your whole order at the same time is highly recommended as dishes are meant to be shared family-style. A 22% service charge will be added to parties of 6+ and $5/person fee will apply for outside desserts served in-house.

name: JŪN
description: Restaurant by Top Chef Alum, Chef Evelyn Garcia and Chef Henry Lu. JUN is a New American restaurant in the Heights; serving chef inspired small to large dishes. Pulling inspiration from the Houston landscape and Texas produce. JŪN also has a full bar creating signature cocktails, selections of craft beer from local brewers as well as an exciting wine list. If you are interested in booking party size 6 and more please email: booking@junbykin.com with your inquires.

name: Turner's Cut
description: Turner’s Cut is Houston’s newest playground for the elite, mixing the sophistication and luxury of the Gilded Age, the indulgence and free-flowing excess of the Golden Era, spiced with the risqué, exclusive, and clandestine aura of prohibition. Featuring the most exquisite and rare cuts of meat from America and Japan, white-glove service, live bandstand music Friday and Saturday evenings, and antique design elements, Turner’s Cut is the most opulent dining experience in the city of Houston.

name: March
description: In the heart of Houston’s Montrose neighborhood, MARCH is an intimate Mediterranean restaurant from Chef Felipe Riccio. Serving a course tasting menu, we study the gastronomy, history, and cultures of the region to answer the question:“What is Mediterranean cuisine?”After many years of personal and professional exploration of the Mediterranean, Felipe has brought this spirit of exploration back to his hometown.The word ‘MARCH’ signifies an area of land on the border between two territories; a frontier between realms. The menu is the team’s love letter to the Mediterranean where we will explore the unique, layered evolution of its many connected cuisines, with beverage pairings/selections artfully curated by partner and Master Sommelier, June Rodil.Chef de Cuisine: Chris DaviesExecutive Pastry Chef: Micaela VictoriaGeneral Manager: Gabriel FontenierWine Director: Anthony SalazarGoodnight Hospitality Partners: Bailey & Peter McCarthy, Felipe Riccio, June Rodil

name: Kiran's
description: James Beard semi-finalist for Best Chef Texas and Top Chef Season 19 judge Kiran Verma, considered the ‘godmother of Indian fine dining,’ has created world-class north Indian cuisine at her eponymous restaurant. Come and enjoy good food and great service in a fabulous environment.Signature dishes include rack of lamb with aloo methi, Chilean sea bass with mango chutney, chicken tikka masala and a vegetarian thali. Specialty cocktails range from the Jahangir Lassi (house-infused pineapple rum, passion fruit, mango lassi, pistachio) to a Chai Old Fashioned to a Cardamom Basil Gin & Tonic.The restaurant serves Afternoon Tea every Friday, Saturday and Sunday - a four-course Indian and English tea experience. Chef Kiran has created her own chai blend.

name: Lee's
description: Lee's celebrates all things Italian, with an amaro, Aperol, and Campari-focused cocktail menu full of bright spritzes. Enjoy irreverent snacks like mozzarella sticks, fried calamari, mushroom pizza, and a chicken parm sandwich in a moody, lounge-inspired atmosphere. Join us Wednesday night for pasta specials and Thursday for our Steak Night!Please note, Lee's is a 21+ establishment, physical photo ID is required for all guests.Named one of 2025's Best Bars in America (Bon Appetit)Nominated for 2026 Best New Bar (James Beard Foundation)

name: Bar Bludorn
description: Memorial's NewUpscale TavernBar Bludorn by Chef Aaron Bludorn is a quintessential neighborhood tavern where Texas-touched dishes and home-grown hospitality merge as a distinctly Houston dining experience.

name: Októ
description: Welcome to Októ, where Mediterranean flavors and vibrant ambiance converge. Named after the Greek word for "eight," Októ offers an upbeat atmosphere with a jazzy bar featuring exclusive spirits. Our menu, crafted by SOf chef Yotam Dolev showcases innovative, nutritious dishes inspired by Greece, Spain, and the Levant.Guests can enjoy a seasonal selection of approximately a dozen shareable plates, reflecting the rich culinary traditions of the Mediterranean. Complementing the food, our bar serves a curated wine list and a range of classic and creative craft cocktails. Októ is designed for communal dining, making each visit a memorable celebration of Mediterranean cuisine and culture.

name: Street To Kitchen
description: Enjoy unapologetically authentic Thai food in the East End. All food is made from scratch by native Thai chef and James Beard Award winner for Best Chef: Texas Benchawan Jabthong Painter.Chef Benchawan and her husband—who also spend time in their Bangkok home each year—have painstakingly built out a restaurant that would fit into Bangkok’s hip Thong Lor neighborhood, but they have located it in Houston. Expect trendy Thai vibes, music, strong cocktails and an adventurous wine list to accompany Chef Benchawan’s acclaimed dishes.When booking your reservation, all children—regardless of age—must be included in the head count. The largest party Street to Kitchen can accommodate is 6 people. If more than 6, you can arrange a private Thai tasting menu, including a minimum spend. Please contact us via email at eatthai@streettokitchen.org to schedule.

name: Midtown Table
description: Welcome to Midtown Table, where the heart of the kitchen meets the soul of the community. As a proud Medure Brothers Concept with a scratch kitchen, we bring a fresh, artisan-inspired approach to the Town Center dining scene. Our menu is a celebration of simple, high-quality ingredients, featuring hand-crafted pastas, house-baked breads and unique signature dishes.Whether you're looking for the Best Outdoor Dining Jacksonville has to offer on our expansive patio or a cozy corner in our modern dining room, Midtown Table provides the perfect backdrop for any occasion. From a feast with the family to a refined evening of craft cocktails and conversation, our space is designed for connection. Experience the warmth of a true neighborhood kitchen where every meal is prepared with passion and served with genuine hospitality. Join us at Midtown Table—Jacksonville's premier destination for inspired, scratch-made cuisine in an inviting, upscale-casual atmosphere.

name: Rue Saint-Marc
description: Rue Saint-Marc is a modern restaurant serving French inspired cuisine in the San Marco neighborhood. We have an extensive cocktail program and a unique wine and craft beer list. The ambiance is stylish while still being quite comfortable. Seating includes tufted leather booths, handmade wooden tables, a beautiful bar-height communal table, and a covered outdoor patio. An open kitchen allows guests to view the chefs in action.

name: Matthew's Restaurant
description: Enjoy a dining experience that enlivens the senses at Matthew’s Restaurant. Located in the historic San Marco district, Chef Matthew Medure’s flagship destination has defined Fine Dining Jacksonville for almost three decades. Our open kitchen delivers a sophisticated Upscale French and Globally inspired experience, where classic techniques meet innovative global influences and the freshest seasonal ingredients.Whether you are joining us for a celebratory Jacksonville Anniversary Dinner or exploring our world-class Chef-Driven Tasting Menu, every visit is a choreographed masterclass in hospitality. Our award-winning wine cellar and meticulously crafted plates offer a sanctuary for the discerning palate. Discover why Matthew’s remains a cornerstone of the Florida dining scene—a place where elegance is effortless and every meal is a celebrated occasion. Immerse yourself in a tradition of excellence and let us redefine your expectations of a truly great meal.

name: Room 39 - Midtown
description: Discover Room 39—where farm-sourced ingredients inspire every meal, from breakfast through dinner. Led by chef-owner Ted Habiger, our menus evolve daily with local producers’ freshest offerings, and our award-winning wine list is curated by expert sommeliers to perfectly complement each dish. For over 20 years, we’ve welcomed guests into a cozy space filled with art, travel, and the personal passions we love to share. Located in the heart of Kansas City’s 39th Street, Room 39 is dedicated to great food and wine enjoyed among good friends in a setting that feels like home.

name: Pierpont's at Union Station
description: Pierpont's at Union Station has been providing food and service as memorable as the historic setting since its inception in 1999. Named for railroad baron J.P. (Pierpont) Morgan, Pierpont's serves perfectly aged prime steaks and fresh seafood arriving daily. To complement your culinary selections, we maintain an extensive wine list featuring bottles from all over the globe, as well as boast a gorgeous 2-story bar equipped with a rolling library ladder.Our Private Dining Rooms-located in the Wine Cellar, along with the Pierpont's Belvedere Room on the 2nd floor overlooking Grand Hall, offer more intimate settings for groups of 6 to 60. They are perfect for business or entertaining guests and each room is individually decorated, offering an exceptional place to celebrate a special occasion, close the deal, or have a gathering with friends.

name: JJ's Restaurant
description: Our James Beard Award(2025) nominated wine list and beverage program is the big draw, but our steaks and seafood are the unsung heroes of the menu. For over 40 years, we have been the go to spot for wine, but many know us as their favorite neighborhood. We also have an outstanding happy hour M-F 3-6pm. Sunday 4-6pm.

name: Esther’s Kitchen
description: Seasonal Italian restaurant by Chef James Trees.  Focused on handmade pasta, bread and pizza created with locally sourced ingredients.We invite you to try our acclaimed sister restaurants Bar Boheme, Ada’s, Al Solito Posto and High Stakes Las Vegas.

name: Dunsmoor
description: Brian Dunsmoor’s namesake restaurant, Dunsmoor, is the latest iteration of his ongoing exploration of American heritage cooking. It is, first and foremost, a restaurant for the community that surrounds it, and a loving expression of the relentless research that has informed his cooking for the last ten years.We offer the full menu at tables in our dining room and at the chef's counter. Reservations are recommended but we make every effort to accommodate walk-ins when possible. Dunsmoor's wine bar, accessible either through the restaurant or via its own door on Ave 35, does not accept reservations and serves a limited menu of our raw and larder items.

name: Bestia
description: A multi-regional Italian restaurant in the Arts District of downtown Los Angeles.

name: Osteria Mozza
description: Presided over by James Beard Award-winning Chef Nancy Silverton, Michelin-starred Osteria Mozza celebrates traditional Italian cuisine and seasonality. From our iconic Mozzarella Bar to exquisite handmade pasta to Grilled Beef Tagliata or our signature Rosemary Olive Oil Cakes, Osteria Mozza has revolutionized Italian cuisine in Los Angeles. Our all-Italian wine list continues this sensibility by offering bottlings from the country's finest producers, with a focus on Piedmont, Friuli and Tuscany. We kindly request you alert your server of any dietary restrictions upon seating or when making your reservation.  For parties of 8, we offer a preselected family-style menu and accept bookings directly through our Reservations line at (323) 297-0100. Additions welcomed, no substitutions. This menu is priced at $100 per guest, not including tax, tip or beverage upon consumption. For bookings larger than 8 guests, please email our Events Team at events@mozza-la.com for more information.

name: Antico Nuovo
description: Antico Nuovo is a restaurant nestled in "East Larchmont Village" that draws inspiration from the Italian countryside.  The menu features Chef Chad Colby's ode to Italian ancient tradition and technique with hand-made pasta, wood-fired meats, vegetables, and fish. Curated and tailored to the menu, the wine program offers a deep dive into varietals from Italy and beyond.

name: Bavel
description: A Middle Eastern restaurant in the Arts District of downtown Los Angeles.

name: Loreto
description: Bathed by the Pacific Ocean to the West and by the Mar de Cortés to the East, California’s Peninsula is layered with a rich history of cultures reinventing seafood with bold flavors. At our Barra de Peninsula we serve the best bounty that these Oceans have to offer, and we celebrate the people who make our coasts so delicious, from Uni and clam divers to the Concheros in Baja and much more.We love celebrating special occasions! While we don’t offer complimentary desserts, we’re happy to add a candle to any dessert you order.Please note: All credit card payments will incur a 3% processing fee. You may use a debit card to avoid this charge. Thank you for your cooperation, and looking forward on hosting you!We love having little ones join us! For everyone's safety, children must remain supervised and seated during service. Our team carries hot dishes and works in tight spaces — we just want to keep everyone safe and happy!

name: Majordōmo
description: Majordōmo, from Dave Chang and Momofuku, serves California cuisine inspired by the different food cultures present in Los Angeles and the bounty of Southern California products. In a sleek, industrial setting with a sun-soaked patio and full bar, Majordōmo offers various ways to dine for groups of all sizes. Executive Chef James Bailey highlights California’s bounty through knockout large format dishes like whole plate short rib and smoked bo ssäm to a constantly changing roster of bings & dips.

name: Republique
description: République, located in Miracle Mile, is owned by Chefs Walter and Margarita Manzke. Centered in the heart of Los Angeles, the historic building in which it resides was originally erected in 1929 by Charlie Chaplin, and later transformed into the iconic La Brea Bakery and Campanile Restaurant. République builds on this storied past, offering a gastronomic environment imbued with history and grandeur. The space features a casual bakery, café, and bar in the front with a more formal dining area located in the rear, serving a French-inspired menu created daily by our chefs.

name: Gwen
description: Gwen Butcher Shop & Restaurant is the second restaurant from fine dining chef Curtis Stone (of Maude) and the first he’s opened with his brother Luke Stone. Gwen is both a European-style, chef-driven butcher shop and a restaurant that is redefining dining in LA, with a menu that calls on fire-based cooking techniques. Whether you’re picking up house-made charcuterie, prime and rare breed meats from the retail store, enjoying a feast in the dining room or relaxing with a bite and cocktail at the bar, Gwen delivers the highest standards of quality, taste and service. If you have any questions, please feel free to call the restaurant at 323-946-7500.

name: Camélia
description: A French-Japanese bistro in the Arts District of Downtown Los Angeles. From July 23 to July 26, we’ll be hosting a multi-night experience exclusively for Chase Sapphire Reserve® cardmembers. Book now: https://www.opentable.com/r/camelia-la/sapphire-summer-reservedReservations are always recommended, but we are often able to accommodate walk-ins as well. While we love dogs, we can only accept trained service animals (not emotional support animals) both in our dining room as well as on our outdoor patio. We appreciate your understanding.

name: Meteora
description: Ignite your senses at Meteora, a dynamic one-star Michelin restaurant by Chef Jordan Kahn (Vespertine, Destroyer). Dinner here showcases live-fire cooking, seasonal ingredients, and flavors inspired by Chef Jordan's travels.  The wine list, curated by wine director James Saidy, spans the globe, emphasizing terroir, expression, and passion. Meanwhile, our bar program highlights artisanal cocktails, ancestral spirits, and exotic ingredients to enhance your dining experience.Created in collaboration with Roth Architecture and Ov&Co, the transportive setting inspires and revitalizes with its lush greenery, rich woods, and artisan-made accents.For private gatherings, groups of 8 to 12 can enjoy our private dining room, The Nest. Groups of 6 to 7 can opt for our semi-private Selenite Crystal Chef’s Table, situated near the kitchen and nestled within a sculpted shell.

name: chi SPACCA
description: Heralded as a "meat speakeasy" by Food & Wine Magazine, chi SPACCA has come to represent the quintessential new Italian dining experience, where accompaniments like the Foccacia di Recco, warm salted Medjool dates, and Culatello & Puglia burrata are just sideshows for the rest of Chef Alisa Vannah's wood-fired menu which features a 42-ounce Tomahawk pork chop, a 36-ounce dry-aged bone-in New York Costata alla Fiorentina, and a 50-ounce dry-aged porterhouse Bistecca Fiorentina.Enchanted by the artistry of Italian salumi culture, we built the first “dry cure” program in Los Angeles so that we could experiment and perfect Italian charcuterie techniques in house.

name: Kato
description: Kato serves seasonally-focused tasting menus influenced by Taiwan and Asian American nostalgia. Main Dining Room Tasting Menu │ $325     The dining room tasting menu focuses on seasonality and innovation.   Bar Tasting Menu │ $185The bar tasting menu is an abbreviated version of the main dining room tasting menu. Guests must be 21 years or older to join us at the bar.An 18% fair wage and operational fee has been added to your bill. It goes to provide elevated, comprehensive benefits, as well as consistent, livable wages for all staff. Though many of our guests choose to leave gratuity for exemplary service, it is neither necessary nor expected, though it is greatly appreciated. This gratuity will be shared by all hourly staff.

name: Baroo
description: Baroo is a relaxed modern Korean fine dining restaurant by Kwang Uh and Mina Park in the Arts District of Downtown Los Angeles. We offer a six-course tasting menu for $140/person (no à la carte options). We have three options for seating: dining room, chef's counter, and bar. Our full tasting menu is offered at all seating options. If you require a vegetarian or vegan tasting menu, please note that in your reservation 24 hours in advance. If we don't receive 24-hours notice for vegetarian or vegan menus, we cannot guarantee availability. Our dishes include gluten, soy, dairy, nuts, sesame, avocado oil, and alliums. Due to the small size of our team, we are unable to accommodate all modification requests. Reservations open 21 days in advance at 10:00am for parties between 1-6 guests. For party size over 6 or information on buyouts, please email us at hello@baroolosangeles.com!

name: Steak 48 - Beverly Hills
description: At Steak 48, we serve the finest steaks and high-quality seafood in an intimate and vibrant setting. Our diverse menu will satisfy any personal craving, as we serve the best USDA prime steaks, succulent seafood, and shellfish along with inventive and classically inspired side dishes and appetizers. Also enjoy classic cocktails and an extensive award-winning wine list. At Steak 48, We encourage all of our guests to get dressed up for a great experience, here is a link to our dress code that you can share with your guests. https://www.steak48.com/steakhouses/beverly-hills/dress-code/Please dress as your elegant selves. You are going to have a great time!If you need any special accommodations or flowers reach out to us at the host desk! We look forward to seeing you soon!

name: Delilah - Los Angeles
description: Swing and jive through this homage to the roaring ‘20s. With its lavish chandeliers and plush interiors, Delilah is a modern-day supper club with a vintage aesthetic. Nostalgic touches like a crackling fireplace offer a warm and welcoming atmosphere as guests dine on refined American fare. Dining turns to dancing as a troupe of female entertainers move to the sounds of a live jazz band. Eating, drinking, and dancing converge in this luxury space as guests enjoy lounge style bottle service as the evening unfolds. Elegant yet alluring, the charm and vivacious energy of Delilah is like stepping back in time.Delilah has a 15 minute grace period for each reservation. Each reservation is allotted 2 hours. Please note, should we not get confirmation by 4pm on the day of your reservation, your table may be released. Dress Code: Smart Causal, No Shorts

name: Super Peach
description: Super Peach is an American restaurant with Korean influences from David Chang and the Momofuku team.

name: The Nice Guy
description: Tucked away in the heart of West Hollywood, The Nice Guy is an intimate restaurant and lounge, complete with world-class culinary offerings. A step above a restaurant, but not quite a club, the venue is a cozy, reservations-only destination for h.wood friends and family. Its aesthetic evokes the decadent lore of mafia bars and restaurants, where the owners and their friends could enjoy an evening together. Whether grabbing an early dinner or mingling into the early morning hours, the space cultivates a feeling of camaraderie among its clientele, which keeps guests coming back night after night.

name: La Dolce Vita
description: La Dolce Vita opened its' doors in Beverly Hills in 1966.  The biggest celebrities in the world lived only moments away, and La Dolce Vita literally became their second home for decades to come.  Regulars included the Sinatras, the Reagans, the Pecks, the Douglases, and the Bloomingdales.  It hosted every sitting US President since the Kennedy administration, and was known as a haven for titans of industry and finance. Deals were made with a handshake, and everyone was certain to arrive on Thursdays for Osso Bucco.  Now, La Dolce Vita moves to the future, following a seven month 'facelift,' during which the restaurant was restored to its' original pristine condition, reprieving the original menu, recipes, and decor.  La Dolce Vita arrives once again as a popular dining and entertainment destination, now home to young Hollywood and those seeking the traditional cuisine of Italy.

name: Anajak Thai Cuisine
description: Anajak is a 44 year-old neighborhood bistro serving up Thai specialties with a notable wine list. James Beard Award Winning Chef, Justin Pichetrungsi, pays homage to his father with his traditional recipes through a vibrant à la carte service and a convivial Thai Taco Tuesday (TTT).For assistance, our reservation team is available Tuesday–Sunday, 11am–7pm at 818-501-4201 or by email at res@anajakthai.com. Follow along for the latest updates at @anajakthaifood and anajakthai.com.

name: Petit Trois Le Valley
description: Petit Trois Le Valley, the second outpost of Chef Ludo Lefebvre's beloved bistro, opened its doors in 2018 in Sherman Oaks. This larger location channels a lavish French Brasserie, with its marble bar, banquette lined dining room, and a Chef’s counter overlooking the open kitchen. The second dining room can be reserved for larger parties and private events. Since opening, Petit Trois has garnered praise from casual foodies and revered food critics. In 2015, Petit Trois was nominated for Best New Restaurant by the James Beard Foundation and in 2019 earned the Bib Gourmand designation upon the Michelin Guide’s return to Los Angeles. Additionally, Petit Trois was featured on the late Jonathan Gold’s 101 Best Restaurants in Los Angeles list from 2015-2017 and has remained on the list since 2019 when Bill Addison & Patricia Escárcega took over.

name: Vespertine
description: Vespertine is Chef Jordan Kahn's culinary symphony. More than a restaurant, Vespertine transports diners through the twisted steel and glass structure designed by acclaimed architect Eric Owen Moss. Food, beverage, music, and art are woven throughout, creating an evocative and immersive evening. Its cuisine exalts exceptional, rare, and thoughtfully sourced ingredients, employing newly invented techniques to create moments of magic, surprise, and delight. Bold and soulful compositions uncover harmonies hidden within. Coupled with heartfelt hospitality and rich storytelling, this is a dining experience where guests leave feeling inspired and renewed. Awards Include:2 Stars - Michelin Guide, 2019 - 2025Green Star - Michelin Guide, 2024 - 2025 Most Beautiful Restaurants - Condé Nast World's 100 Greatest Places - Time MagazineAtmosphere of the Year - World Restaurant Awards

name: Amiga Amore
description:
## Amiga Amore: A Culinary Fusion of Italy and Mexico in Los Angeles

Nestled in the heart of Los Angeles, Amiga Amore is a unique restaurant that seamlessly blends the vibrant flavors of Italy and Mexico. Founded by a husband-and-wife team, Alessandro Zecca and Danielle Duran Zecca, this culinary gem offers an unforgettable dining experience that transcends traditional boundaries.

The restaurant's cozy and intimate atmosphere sets the stage for a delightful culinary journey. The exposed brick walls and warm lighting create a welcoming ambiance, while the open kitchen allows guests to witness the artistry of the chefs firsthand.

Amiga Amore's menu is a testament to the couple's passion for both Italian and Mexican cuisine. Each dish is meticulously crafted with fresh, seasonal ingredients, showcasing the harmonious marriage of these two distinct culinary traditions.

Start your meal with the "noprese" salad, a refreshing combination of nopales, hibiscus salt, and house-made stracciatella. For a heartier option, try the elote agnolotti, plump corn-filled pasta bursting with flavor. The pork chop milanese, encrusted with crushed tortillas and served with a cilantro-laced arugula salad, is a must-try for meat lovers.

No meal at Amiga

name: Harriet's
description:
Harriet's, located on the rooftop of the 1 Hotel, preserves the values of an old-fashioned cocktail lounge with jaw-dropping, panoramic views of Los Angeles. Revelry with a view, our bar is stocked with fresh and seasonal ingredients alongside some of the finest and approachable spirits. 

With a curated cocktail menu, lounging daytime drinks turn into evenings and evenings into late nights.

Entrance located on the lobby level with dedicated elevator up to the 9th floor of the West Tower.

Please note that reservations may only be made online. If there is no availability online, we regret that there is no availability for that date and time.

name: Citrin
description: Citrin is a modern Californian cuisine restaurant by Chef Josiah Citrin. The attention to detail and pursuit of excellence that defined Josiah’s landmark Mélisse restaurant for 20 years thrives in this new space. Citrin is a fun, welcoming, and approachable experience. A large bar and a la Carte menu brings a fresh take on our love of hospitality and passion to deliver exciting and delicious food.

name: Ocean 48 - Newport
description: The Ocean 48 menu is designed with fresh seafood and quality ingredients in mind. The Mastros provide ultra-grade seafood, salmon, lobster, crab, oysters and more. Much of the menu is served a la carte, letting each guest personalize their experience. Ocean 48 is seafood reinvented in a vibrant upscale atmosphere specializing in world-class seafood & great steaks. Different than anything we have done in the past, the fine dining atmosphere blends dramatic and intimate settings. At the core of Ocean 48 is chef sourced, highest graded sustainable fresh seafood from around from the world, enhanced with unique and interesting appetizers and side dishes that go beyond the traditional seafood menu. Newport's best seafood & romantic restaurant.

name: Melisse
description: Chef & Owner Josiah Citrin has revived his Michelin 2-Star institution with an intimate, 14-seat restaurant with Chef/Partner Ken Takayama. In a setting that blurs the line between kitchen and dining room, Chefs and service staff guide guests through a 2.5-hour culinary experience.Collaborating with California farmers from San Diego to Napa Valley, Chef Josiah sources the most unique and exclusive ingredients available. An 8-course tasting menu is bookended by canapés, amuse-bouches and mignardise, all of which showcase global flavors using both modern and classic techniques.

name: REGARDS
description: Bringing some LA vibes to the northeast.  REGARDS draws inspiration from the diverse food culture of Los Angeles.  We highlight flavor profiles from Japan and Mexico with the freshest of Maine produce and products.  The menu at REGARDS has bright, zippy ceviches and crudos, rich tamales, plump Argentinian shrimp tacos, along with mezcal cured hamachi collars, crab rice and grilled cabbage with caesar. Clarified lime margaritas with eucalyptus or our gin and sotol martinis with hibiscus pair with our adventurous menu.  We pour natural wine and have a large selection of curated mezcals and tequilas.A place for us and for you.  Might not make sense, but it sure is delicious.  Across the street from Reny's.  Nearby Maine College of Art, Portland Stage Company, State Theatre, Empire Comedy Club and Blue Jazz Club.  **The 50 Best New Restaurants of 2022, Bon Appetit****Plate Magazine Chef's To Watch, 2023****Star Chef New England, 2023**

name: Benny's
description: Benny's is a Philly-inspired, Italian-American restaurant in Portland's Arts District, from the team behind Ramona's Sandwich Shop. Enjoy a signature cocktail at our 14-seat bar, or settle down at a table for a night of classic dishes such as Meatballs, Linguine and Clams, Chicken Parmesan, or Pretzel Garlic Knots. Younger guests can enjoy a Shirley Temple while snacking on Mozzarella Sticks and a bowl of Spaghetti. Our dining room is fit for date nights and celebratory evenings. Benny’s is all about balance—nostalgic, comforting dishes made with the best ingredients and some modern twists for creative fun.

name: Mr. Tuna
description: A casual sushi joint in Portland, ME specializing in sustainable, local seafood. Mr. Tuna includes a poppy, pastel-shaded 30 seat sushi bar and seasonal outdoor seating. Chef Jordan Rubin is hyper focused on quality, earning accolades including a James Beard Nominee for Best Chef: Northeast and Food & Wine Best New Chef in 2025. Mr. Tuna was named #6 Best Restaurant in the Country by Food & Wine and was honored with the Innovation Award from Gulf of Maine Research Institute for its commitment to responsible sourcing. The menu is built around super-fresh, seasonal seafood sourced straight from the Gulf of Maine, as the restaurant is just a short walk up from Portland's waterfront. Try the Tuna Tasting, a four-cut journey through local bluefin, or the Tuna de Tigre, a bright, ceviche-style blend of Peruvian and Thai flavors. Don't skip the classics- the hand rolls are what brought Mr. Tuna to fame in the early food cart days. Save room for a hot pressed ice cream Toastie for dessert!

name: MILA
description: Located in the heart of Miami Beach, MILA is a MediterrAsian multi-experience venue that combines an elevated culinary journey with a magical, glamorous, and vibrant atmosphere. Designed to celebrate the night in style, MILA immerses guests in eclectic sounds and embraces the effortless beauty of the five elements. This unique destination awakens all the senses with refined flavors, bespoke mixology, transporting ethnic rhythms, and unparalleled ambiance. Explore the different experiences at MILA Restaurant, MILA Lounge, MILA Omakase, and the exclusive members-only space, MM.

name: Delilah - Miami
description: Delilah Miami is a modern-day supper club that brings a vibrant flair to the heart of Brickell. This vintage-inspired sanctuary immerses guests in Miami’s sultry spirit set aglow by lavish chandeliers that cast a warm glow upon its plush interior. Within this haven, guests are enveloped in nostalgia by the gentle crackling of the fireplace and the embrace of overstuffed armchairs, elevating comfort while indulging on exquisite American fare.Dining elevates to dancing as a troupe of female entertainers move to the sounds of a live jazz band. Eating, drinking, and dancing blur while guests relish in lounge-style bottle service deep into the rhythm of the night…oh yeah.

name: Luca Osteria
description: Luca Osteria is a standout culinary destination located on the pedestrian-friendly Giralda Plaza in the heart of Coral Gables, brought to life by Chopped champion Chef Giorgio Rapicavoli. The restaurant represents Rapicavoli's lifelong dream of reimagining his family's timeless Italian recipes with a fresh, contemporary perspective. Luca Osteria is celebrated for delivering an inventive, "classic yet unpredictable" take on traditional Italian cooking, seamlessly blending authentic, generations-old techniques with subtle Miami-inspired flair. It offers an exceptional, ingredient-driven dining experience within a chic but approachable space, proving once again that high-level culinary execution thrives in a vibrant, bustling neighborhood setting.

name: Cafe La Trova
description: The world famous Julio Cabrera and his team of Cantineros bring to life the retro Cuba atmosphere with their artisanal, handcrafted cocktails. James Beard Award Winning Chef Michelle Bernstein lends her culinary prowess with a contemporary take on Cuban-styled dishes. Immerse yourself in Miami Cuban culture with live music played by real Trova musicians.

name: Eating House
description: Eating House Miami is a beloved culinary staple that originally began as a wildly successful pop-up in 2012 before cementing its status as one of Miami's most iconic dining destinations. Now situated on the pedestrian-friendly Giralda Plaza in the heart of Coral Gables, the restaurant is helmed by Chopped champion Chef Giorgio Rapicavoli. Eating House is celebrated for redefining modern Miami cuisine by blending the city's diverse culinary heritage with playful, nostalgic comfort food. It delivers an inventive, locally sourced dining experience within an unpretentious, high-energy neighborhood atmosphere, proving that high-level culinary execution doesn't require a stuffy environment.

name: Los Félix Miami
description: At Los Félix, we celebrate the vibrant spirit of Mexican cuisine through the ancestral wisdom of Milpa farming—a sacred tradition that honors the connection between land and self. Our kitchen shines with native ingredients like heirloom corn, cacao, chiles, and squash, all brought to life in our in-house Molino, where maíz is cooked and ground daily for tortillas made from scratch.Helmed by Chef Sebastián Vargas, whose culinary journey bridges indigenous technique with modern artistry, Los Félix has earned both a MICHELIN Star for excellence and a MICHELIN Green Star for sustainability. Whether you're joining us for a soulful brunch or an intimate dinner, expect a journey from Milpa to mesa—where every dish tells a story, and every bite carries intention.On weekends, the energy rises with vinyl-spun DJ sets that turn the room into a celebration of sound, flavor, and community. Come for the food, stay for the vibe!

name: Zitz Sum
description: Zitz Sum is a 30 seat seasonal restaurant located inside of an historic building in Coral Gables, Florida. Our story, is a story of resilience, passion & commitment, that is translated in a plate of food, excellent service and unapologetic gracious hospitality.  Our current menu is an autobiographical journey reflecting Chef’s experiences and our affinity for Japanese ingredients and technique. We currently offer A la carte menu that changes with the seasons, and a Seven Course Tasting Menu that changes weekly. Our tasting menu consists of playful snacks and bites to get the night going, and an array of our signature and favorite current dishes. Part of the tasting menu is presented in a family style format conducive for sharing and celebrating. Zitz Sum is recipient of a 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 & 2026 Michelin Guide Bib Gourmand Award, a 2022 James Beard Foundation Semifinalist for Best New Restaurant and a New York Times 2022 Best 50 Restaurants in America.

name: Krüs Kitchen
description: They say the kitchen is the heart of every home—and at the heart of Coconut Grove, Krüs Kitchen pulses with the vision of Chef Sebastián Vargas. With a résumé that spans MICHELIN-starred icons like Osteria Francescana, Eleven Madison Park, and Fäviken Magasinet, Chef Vargas brings a globally refined, culturally rooted perspective to every plate.At Krüs, the menu evolves with the seasons, spotlighting consciously sourced ingredients and deep relationships with local farmers and purveyors. The result is more than a meal—it’s a high-vibe invitation to connect, nourish, and become part of a community grounded in flavor and integrity.Join us for a vibrant lunch of fresh salads, hearty sandwiches, and homemade market treats. By evening, our rotating dinner menu channels Miami’s energy with peak-season ingredients and bold, expressive dishes. Every visit is a chance to experience the rhythm of Krüs—where heritage meets innovation, and every bite tells a story.

name: Phuc Yea
description: Phuc Yea offers a selection of shareable plates that capture the soulfulness and passion behind family-rooted recipes, the restaurant is inspired by Aniece Meinhold's Vietnamese heritage and Cesar Zapata's Third Coast culinary roots. Under one roof, guests are invited to marvel at Biscayne's blossoming Mimo District; embrace 90's hip-hop, street-cool music; and enjoy Cesar's version of Viet- Cajun cuisine - a lively mash up of fresh and colorful Vietnamese ingredients pumped up with spicy, bold Cajun flavors. This grown up version of Phuc Yea is largely seafood driven.Brunch features a dim sum style menu that highlights classic American brunch preparations. It is at brunch, Chef Zapata will feature his Gulf and Southern influences more prominently while still integrating Vietnamese breakfast tradition.

name: Taki Omakase- Boca Raton
description: Taki Omakase at Boca Raton presents a traditional Tokyo-style Omakase, also known as Edomae-style. Edomae-style is centered on meticulous fish preparation. Master chefs utilize time-honored techniques including dry-aging, wet-aging, kombu-jime, and precise marinades of salt, vinegar, and soy sauce to bring out the unique expression of every ingredient.**Please review our menu to explore the seasonality of summer.**Business Meals | Special Occasions | Anniversary | Birthday | Milestone Gathering | Family Reunion Dinner | Date Night | Networking | Authentic Japanese Cuisine | Sake Pairing | Chef's Table

name: Taki Omakase - Delray
description: Taki Omakase offers an intimate Japanese dining experience in Delray Beach, featuring a chef’s choice menu of traditional nigiri, innovative seafood dishes, and premium wagyu. Our chefs showcase exceptional seasonal ingredients and fresh seafood imported from Japan, thoughtfully preparing each course to highlight its natural flavor and quality.We are open by reservation only. Please visit OpenTable for our daily seating times and review terms before booking.Dinner Omakase is $180 per guest; Lunch Omakase is $100 per guest. Tax and a mandatory 20% gratuity will be added to the final check.A 50% deposit is required per guest ($90 for dinner or $50 for lunch) and applied to the final bill.***Any changes or cancellations occur WITHIN the 24 hour period of your reservation day and time will forfeit your deposit/refund. ***Our menu prominently features raw fish. We cannot accommodate vegan or vegetarian diets. Please disclose all allergies and dietary restrictions when booking.

name: Porzana
description: A modern-Argentinian wood fire steakhouse, with a wide variety of seafood, vegetable and pasta dishes. We also have private event options that showcase the best of what we have to offer. DANIEL DEL PRADOBorn in Buenos Aires, Argentina, Chef Daniel del Prado is the child of parents of Spanish and southern Italian descent. After moving to the United States in his early 20s, del Prado began his culinary career in Colorado—cooking at night and snowboarding during the day. Upon moving to Minneapolis, he had the opportunity to work in some of the finest kitchens in the Twin Cities. In 2009 del Prado teamed up with his mentor, Isaac Becker, to open Bar La Grassa in the North Loop. When it came time for del Prado to open his own concepts, he burst onto the Twin Cities scene with his premiere Linden Hills restaurant, Martina, and opened the Oaxacan Mexican-influenced Colita just a year after. Chef del Prado has continued to open new and innovative concepts.

name: P.S. Steak
description: As the name suggests, P.S. Steak was established to continue the story of the historic space that was once famed La Belle Vie. As Chef Mike DeCamp spent 10 years at the former French restaurant, this will be his homecoming and opportunity to write his own chapter for the space. P.S. Steak disrupts the perceptions of a typical steakhouse while honoring the legacy of one of the great culinary foundations in the Twin Cities. The restaurant features an elevated yet accessible seasonal menu, along with a variety of cuts of meat, dry aged in a display case.The lounge has been given a modern makeover with chic furniture and marble table tops. A selection of living floor plants divides tables to create intimate seating. Bringing warmth to the room, the bar and adjacent fireplace keeps guests cozied up to a menu of progressive cocktails.

name: Baldamar
description: If you're going to take your name from a badass like the patron saint of blacksmiths, you better be able to back it up. Baldamar marks the turning point where we usher in the new standard for style, service and steak. It means the menu’s made with old-world craft at its core and modern day meat eaters in mind — with flavors forged in fire and folded into pure primal perfection. It’s where every steak is aged 40 days and 40 nights for a taste of biblical proportion, and where crazy-fresh seafood means it was caught during your morning commute. At the bar sits every spirit imaginable, and someone who isn’t afraid to use them. This is more than a new steakhouse. It’s a line in the sand. It’s not just where you celebrate special occasions. It’s where you create them.*A 20% Service Fee is added to all groups of 6 or more.

name: Blackbird Modern Asian - Naples
description: Walk-ins are always welcome! Bar and Lounge are first-come, first-serve. If you would like to make a reservation for a party of 7 or more, please contact us at hello@blackbirdmodernasian.com or (239) 944-2473About Us:    *  Voted Top 100 Independent Restaurants in America — Restaurant Business Magazine    *  Voted number 1 restaurant in Palm Beach County— Yelp Broward/Palm Beach

name: Tigress Rooftop Restaurant & Bar
description: Tigress Cantonese Chophouse perches atop The Perry Hotel, Naples, on the seventh-floor rooftop. Chef Dale Talde's innovative menu blends Cantonese flavors with American chophouse classics. Indulge in Dry-Aged Crown of Duck, Black Angus Rib-Eye with soy black garlic butter, and Blue Crab Fried Rice. Savor panoramic views of the River and Gulf while enjoying a romantic dinner or celebrating a special occasion.Just steps away, Easy Tiger Rooftop Bar awaits, an open-air oasis designed by mixology legend Lynnette Marrero. Her inventive cocktails, like the Tigress-Tini and Hong Kong Old-Fashioned, complement Tigress' diverse menu perfectly.Whether you're savoring a delectable dish at Tigress or sipping a crafted cocktail at Easy Tiger, both venues offer an unforgettable experience. Immerse yourself in world-class cuisine and cocktails while enjoying breathtaking views.

name: Ocean Prime - Naples
description: Located on Naples' icon Fifth Avenue South, Ocean Prime is a nationally acclaimed, dynamic seafood & steakhouse from the award-winning Cameron Mitchell Restaurants. Ocean Prime delivers an elevated experience with exceptional ambiance, a chef-curated menu, signature handcrafted cocktails, Wine Spectator honored wine list and genuine hospitality. Reservations are recommended.Ocean Prime strives to provide an elegant, fine dining atmosphere. Our associates’ priority is to ensure your experience is memorable. We ask that our guests choose attire that is both polished and suited to our restaurant.THANK YOU FOR NOT WEARING: Clothing emitting excessive marijuana odor, Excessively revealing clothing or exposed undergarments, Clothing with offensive language or graphics,Ball caps or flip flops. Admittance to Ocean Prime is at the discretion of management who reserves the right to refuse service to patrons who are inappropriately dressed.

name: Oise Ristorante - Fort Myers
description: Oise is a Italian restaurant with Japanese inspirations, this concept is lead by Miami based and James Beard Award-nominated Chef Brad Kilgore! Blending the precision of Italian traditional dishes that we all know and love with a fun and delicious Japanese touch. Our sushi program compliments the menu along with a wonderful offering of grilled items from our Yakitori style grill station. Overall if you are looking for a new, delicious experience in downtown Ft. Myers we are the location for you. Signature dishes like the Truffle Sesame Carbonara and Chicken Parm katsu showcase our commitment exciting flavors and Chef Brads takes on Classics. The cocktail program is unlike any other in the area, hand made from scratch infusions and syrups to create a specialty list alongside classics cocktails will complete the wonderful Oise dining experience.

name: Rolf and Daughters
description:
Rolf and Daughters serves seasonal New American cooking in Germantown, inside Nashville's historic Werthan factory. Chef and owner Philip Krajeck describes it as modern peasant food: shareable plates built on house made pasta, house baked bread, wood fired cooking, and vegetables from regional farms.

The bar keeps an evolving natural wine list alongside house cocktails, and communal tables sit beside the dining room and bar. Dinner nightly from 5pm. Reservations are taken for the dining room, communal tables, and bar, and a few bar seats are held each night for walk ins.

Open since late 2012. Named No. 3 on Bon Appétit's Hot 10 in 2013 and by Esquire the same year. Philip Krajeck, James Beard finalist 2022. In the MICHELIN Guide.

name: Locust Nashville
description: **September reservations will open Saturday, August 1st at 10:00am** ** Please note that the party size confirmed at booking is considered final, and the deposit paid is considered to be a minimum spend. Reductions in guest count upon arrival will result in forfeiture of deposit. If you'd like to adjust your guest count, please reach out ahead of your reservation to info@locustnashville.com.  Locust brings a chaotic elegance to Nashville's dining scene. Chef Trevor Moran and team carefully assemble an ever-changing menu highlighting seafood and local, seasonal products: think raw bar selection, whole grilled fish, a decadent crab omelette, a big steak, all rounded out with a somehow chewy and soft shaved ice. In November 2025, Locust was awarded a MICHELIN Star.Lunch: Friday - Sunday 12:00 PM - 3:00 PM (reservations required)Dinner: Friday - Sunday 6:00 PM - 9:00 PM (reservations required)*Locust is a CARD ONLY establishment, and does not accept cash payments at this time.

name: Bastion
description: **September reservations will open Saturday, August 1st at 12:00pm** Bastion is the 24-seat restaurant of James Beard Foundation Award Nominee Chef Josh Habiger.  It is located in a separate area within the casual cocktail bar of the same name, and it is a part of Nashville's Wedgewood Houston neighborhood.  In November 2025, Bastion was awarded a MICHELIN Star.Bastion's dining room features counter seating around the kitchen for parties of 2 as well as three tables for parties of 3 to 6.  Bastion's small team serves a weekly set menu of six dinner courses featuring many dishes with a wide variety of flavors, ingredients, and inspirations.  Friendly service guides you through the culinary experience, which also features wine pairings, creative cocktails, and a curated vinyl soundtrack.  Come early or stay late in the hidden Little Bar, which is a private offering for guests of the restaurant.

name: Peninsula
description: Located in the heart of East Nashville, Peninsula serves up sharable plates, old world wines, and Spanish style gin and tonics in an inviting and intimate space. James Beard winner Chef Jake Howell's menu focuses on sustainable, local ingredients and features seasonal, creative dishes influenced by the Iberian Peninsula. Guests are encouraged to sample the flavors of Spain, Portugal and France while enjoying the rustic, yet modern surrounds.

name: Bad Idea
description: Bad Idea is a wine bar and restaurant in East Nashville focused on Contemporary American cooking and seasonal, locally sourced ingredients. Founded by Alex Burch, recipient of the Michelin American South Sommelier Award 2025, the concept places wine at the center of the experience, with a dynamic, food-friendly list designed for exploration and balance.The culinary program is directed by David Breeden, whose approach emphasizes technique, restraint, and letting exceptional ingredients speak for themselves. The result is a refined yet approachable neighborhood destination for both casual evenings and special occasions. Bad Idea was also named a semifinalist for Best New Restaurant in the 2025 James Beard Awards.

name: Henrietta Red
description: Located in Nashville's Germantown neighborhood, Henrietta Red is an acclaimed oyster bar and restaurant. It boasts a welcoming barroom, spacious dining room, oyster bar, and a temperature-controlled, enclosed patio.Henrietta Red’s approach to dining centers on fresh, seasonal dishes intended for sharing, fostering an inviting atmosphere ideal for meals with familiar and new friends. Our menu highlights local TN produce and responsibly sourced seafood, offering an extensive variety of oysters from coast to coast. Henrietta Red was named one of America’s 50 Best New Restaurants by Bon Appétit, one of GQ’s Best New Restaurants in America, and a James Beard Foundation Awards Semifinalist for Best New Restaurant in 2018. Chef Julia has been recognized as one of the Best Young Chefs in America by Robb Report and as one of Food & Wine Magazine’s Best New Chefs in 2018. She was also a 2019 semifinalist and 2020 Nominee for Best Chef: Southeast by the James Beard Foundation Awards.

name: Red Hook Tavern
description: Red Hook Tavern brings classic American tavern fare to the waterfront village in Brooklyn, where friends can share a bottle of wine, a few laughs, and a great meal. We hope from the moment you walk into this beautiful old space it makes you feel as special as it did the first time I walked in, almost five years ago. Cheers, Billy

name: Manhatta
description: Manhatta is a modern New York restaurant in the heart of downtown, shaped by the pace and energy of the city. The kitchen is helmed by Executive Chef Michele Brogioni, whose ever-evolving menu draws on traditional techniques and global influences. We offer a prix fixe lunch and multi-course dinner in the dining room, each paired with an award-winning wine list. In the bar, an à la carte menu is served daily.

name: Musaafer - New York
description: Musaafer, meaning traveller, is a dining experience set in opulent space showcasing the art and architecture of India. Chef was sent on an ambitious task of traveling all the states of India; gathering stories and experiences along the way and bringing home age-old regional recipes, which have been translated into our eclectic menu, making the journey an integral part of our menu and regional offerings. You will find Musaafer in the heart of TriBeCa, an opulent Indian restaurant with stunning interiors, custom made and shipped from India. Guests are treated to unforgettable Indian cuisine, a world-class wine program and unparalleled hospitality.Please note our policy regarding children dining at Musaafer: our dining room is designed to welcome children over the age of 10

name: Tavern Next Door
description: I've been dreaming of creating a cocktail bar for years now and proud to say today it becomes a reality. Based on one crazy night in Paris many years ago Tavern Next Door comes to life. My brother Conor Johns leads the way with reinvented disco era cocktails that are sublime. Some fun snacks and yes we will have a version of the Burger there as well. Please come hang in this dreamy lounge that we already love so much.

name: Sailor
description: Sailor is a neighborhood bistro celebrating Chef April Bloomfield’s menu of elevated takes on familiar dishes. At the heart of the restaurants is it's deep wine list, which ranges from easy drinkers through classics and more esoteric selections. Tying it all together is the thoughtful service that Happy Cooking Hospitality has become known for.

name: Don Angie
description: Don Angie is an intimate restaurant serving up a modern ode to Italian-American cuisine by husband and wife chefs and co-owners Angela Rito and Scott Tacinelli, in partnership with Quality Branded. Located in the heart of New York City’s West Village, the restaurant’s menu reimagines comforting dishes from Angie and Scott’s childhoods, with distinctive twists, often drawing inspiration from their collective travels.  Shortly after opening, Don Angie earned a 2-star critic’s pick review from the New York Times and named one of Esquire’s Best New Restaurants in America in 2018. Scott and Angie earned nominations from the James Beard Foundation in 2019, 2020 2022, and 2025. In May 2021, Don Angie was awarded a Michelin star.

name: Razza - Jersey City
description: Razza is an intimate pizzeria  in Jersey City, NJ centered around wood-fired pizzas made with locally sourced ingredients. Chef and owner Dan Richer, a six-time James Beard Award–nominated chef, is known for challenging conventional pizza-making practices with the goal of elevating the craft of pizza in America. The restaurant offers seasonally driven small plates, housemade bread and butter and a thoughtfully curated bar program. The only pizzeria to receive a three-star review from The New York Times, Razza was named Best Pizza in North America by 50 Top Pizza in 2019. The restaurant and Chef Dan Richer have been featured on Somebody Feed Phil, CBS Saturday morning and CNN’s Breaking Bread. Reservations are available 28 days in advance at noon.

name: San Sabino
description: San Sabino is an Italian-American seafood restaurant from the wife and husband chef team behind Don Angie -- Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli -- in partnership with Quality Branded.Angie and Scott opened Don Angie in 2018 to tremendous critical acclaim, and quickly became known for boldly unexpected dishes that challenge your perception of traditional Italian-American cooking. Six years later and just a few doors down from Don Angie, they've now opened their second restaurant, San Sabino. Named after Scott’s grandfather (from Sanza, Italy, where most people are named after the patron saint Sabino), San Sabino offers a playful spin on Italian dishes from Shrimp Parm to Pasta Alle Vongole, with bold twists influenced by coastal American cities where many Italians settled, from New Orleans to the Jersey Shore.

name: Felina Steak- Jersey City
description: Located directly on the Hudson River, Felina Steak is a sleek, modern shrine to Italian-inspired steaks, chops, and seafood. The entrance showcases a dry-aging room with prime cuts and a two-tiered live lobster tank. Inside, an open kitchen adds energy to the intimate dining room, where guests enjoy views of the Manhattan skyline and the Statue of Liberty while watching the culinary team work with focus and precision. The menu is globally inspired yet rooted in bold, flavor-driven dishes that highlight high-quality ingredients and thoughtful techniques. Guests can sip expertly crafted cocktails at our bar, Nove, or explore our curated wine list with help from our sommelier. Whether you're here for a night out or a special occasion, Felina Steak delivers a unique and elevated experience. Outdoor dining is now available on a first come, first served basis, weather permitting. Be sure to visit the Stork Club Rooftop after dinner for more cocktails and breathtaking views.

name: Parcelle Chinatown
description: Parcelle Chinatown, located at 135 Division Street, is a great spot for dinner or a casual wine-and-snack hangout, and if you're feeling spontaneous, there's always room for walk-ins.The upstairs main room features vintage furniture and cozy seating. Known for their robust wine list that highlights both classics and unique finds.Downstairs, you'll find their Studio Room, an intimate venue used for private events. When not booked, it transforms into a cocktail bar open to the public Thursday through Saturday.

name: SAPPEISAN
description: SAPPE is a trip to explore something unique, authentic and ethereal. Our guest will be indulged and pampered through all their five perceptions; visual, auditory, olfactory, haptic and gustatory. SAPPE is the extraordinary place where people come to rejoice and revel. The train market and street food style are what SAPPE aim to offer. The vibe of bustling ambience of train station, the food stalls that offer street bites ‘ปิ้งย่าง (Ping-Yang)’ which is variety of grilled goodies on bamboo skewers and BBQ, as well as the bold flavor of E-San style cuisine are what SAPPE is looking to introduce.

name: Maddy Rose at Liberty House
description: Where bold flavors meet unbeatable waterfront city views. Whether you’re diving into our perfectly seared steaks, ultra-fresh seafood, or signature craft cocktails, every bite (and sip) is a vibe. We offer a menu that speaks to every palate.You may remember us as Liberty House, and rest assured, we are still the same mouthwatering food and cocktails, unmatched level of hospitality, and unbeatable skyline waterfront views, we just decided to rename the restaurant after our daughter, Maddy Rose.Located on the Jersey City waterfront, Maddy Rose Restaurant offers a dining experience like no other. With panoramic views of the New York City skyline, indulge in expertly prepared steaks, fresh seafood, and elevated yet approachable cuisine that brings bold flavors to every plate. Whether you're joining us for a romantic dinner, a lively night out, or cocktails by the water, our restaurant is designed to impress.

name: Union Square Cafe
description: Founded in 1985, Union Square Cafe pioneered a new way of dining, drawing inspiration from the Union Square Greenmarket and showcasing the best local ingredients in a casual and contemporary dining room characterized by warmth and hospitality. Having trained and mentored scores of restaurant professionals for over three decades, Union Square Cafe is the birthplace of a generation of renowned restaurants, chefs, and restaurateurs.The restaurant has won five James Beard Awards and ranked in first place on Zagat Survey’s Most Popular Restaurant list an unprecedented nine times.

name: Ci Siamo
description: Ci Siamo translates to "here we are" or "we've finally arrived." It's the clinking of glasses after a long week, the rush of arriving at a new destination, the relief of a familiar smile — it's an exhalation. Celebrating the beauty of simplicity, Chef Hillary Sterling centers her Italian-inflected menu around live-fire cooking and seasonal ingredients, bridging the traditional with the contemporary in a transportive yet familiar space.

name: Momofuku Noodle Bar - Uptown
description: At this second location, David Chang rethinks his iconic noodle shop. The Columbus Circle Noodle Bar serves a constantly changing roster of noodles, steamed breads made in-house, soft serve, and daily dishes, in a sleek wood-accented space. Bar-wise, there’s a full selection of beer, wine, sake, and cocktails, with a focus on highballs. Stop by for a quick bite at the kitchen counter, or book the private dining room for a celebratory event.Noodle Bar Uptown accepts reservations 30 days in advance starting at 10 am. Although making a reservation is recommended, walk-ins are welcome and can be accommodated at the bar or at tables if space permits.For parties larger than 9 guests, please visit the Private Events page on our website.

name: Una Pizza Napoletana
description: Reservations open 14 days in advance at 9 AM ET.Chef/Owner Anthony Mangieri has been crafting naturally-leavened, wood-fired pizzas with meticulous attention to detail since 1996. A pioneer of Neapolitan pizza in the U.S., Anthony still makes every ball of dough by hand and is at Una making pizza every night. A few starters and desserts complement the pizzas, along with wines from Campania and Champagne. Everything is made fresh daily until sold out. The choice to have only one location allows for an obsessive focus on every detail.Una has been awarded #1 pizzeria in the world by 50 Top Pizza for 2022, 2024, and 2025, a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand, and recognized in media outlets including the TODAY Show, CBS Mornings, and Esquire. Open Thursday, Friday and Saturday. Reservations from 5:00 - 9:30 for parties of up to four. Reservations that have been traded or purchased through third party platforms will not be honored.

name: Kabawa
description: Kabawa, a deeply personal restaurant from Chef Paul Carmichael and Momofuku, offers a nuanced and distinct perspective on Caribbean cuisine. Built around a set menu with plenty of choices, it’s a place to take your time, enjoy a meal, and discover something new each time you visit.Kabawa’s menu is a three-course, $150 prix fixe experience, exclusive of beverage, tax, and gratuity.  The restaurant is divided between kitchen counter seating, an immersive experience with direct chef service, or more secluded table seating.Structured to showcase the depth and diversity of Caribbean cuisine, our ingredients are thoughtfully procured, fusing local produce from neighborhoods right here in New York with specialty items sourced directly from the Caribbean. Every touch point — from the custom mosaics to the ingredient sourcing to the instrumental music — is intentional, tapping into Chef Paul’s upbringing in Barbados to reflect the vibrant, welcoming spirit of a Caribbean home.

name: Scarr's Pizza
description: First opened in 2016 and located on Orchard Street, where the LES, Chinatown and Dimes Square converge, Scarr's Pizza has been called, "The best slice in New York." With a focus on all-natural and organic ingredients, owner and 2024 James Beard Nominee (Best Chef NY State) Scarr Pimentel has crafted not only the best tasting slice in the city, but the healthiest too. Skip the line, book a table and come in for a pie. There is a full bar and the dine-in menu features the crowd favorite Hotboi and Clark Kent as well as exclusive items like the Calzones.

name: The Dining Room at Gramercy Tavern
description: In the Dining Room, a warm and welcoming setting frames a more refined expression of our seasonal menu. At dinner, the menu is centered around a five-course, prix fixe seasonal experience. At lunch, guests may choose between a three-course prix fixe or à la carte.Revered as one of the country’s great American restaurants, Gramercy Tavern has welcomed guests for over three decades with contemporary seasonal cuisine, warm hospitality, and thoughtful service. Rooted in the rhythms of the harvest and shaped by enduring relationships with local farms and the nearby Union Square Greenmarket, Chef Michael Anthony’s ever-evolving menus unfold across two distinct experiences.

name: l'abeille
description: Nestled on a charming Tribeca cobblestone street corner, l’abeille is an intimate sanctuary where French culinary artistry meets Japanese finesse. With only 48 seats, this hidden gem captivates diners with its seasonal Chef’s Tasting Menu, meticulously crafted by the visionary Chef Mitsunobu Nagae. Drawing on his rich experience from Michelin-starred establishments in Tokyo, Paris, and New York, including a recent tenure as Chef de Cuisine at Shun in Midtown Manhattan, Chef Mitsu curates a symphony of flavors that transcend borders.At l’abeille, guests experience a harmonious blend of French sophistication and Japanese precision. Complementing the exquisite tasting menu is a rotating selection of seasonal a-la-carte dishes, thoughtfully paired with selections from the wine cellar and a captivating cocktail program. Immerse yourself in an unparalleled dining experience at l’abeille, where each dish tells a story and every moment is a celebration of culinary excellence.

name: Muku
description: Muku (“無垢”), meaning “purity” or “innocence,” is a Japanese restaurant in New York City led by award-winning Chef Manabu Asanuma, whose experience spans acclaimed kitchens in New York, Japan, and Taiwan.
