Rooted in seasonality, simplicity, and intention, Muku draws inspiration from kaiseki while celebrating "goho" - the five classical techniques of Japanese cooking: raw, grilled, simmered, steamed, and fried. Each dish is crafted with restraint, using only what enhances the true character of the ingredients, resulting in a focused, expressive cuisine that honors tradition while offering a refined, modern Japanese dining experience.Guests are welcome to bring bottles not featured on our beverage list to enjoy with our menu. Corkage is $175 per 720ml sake bottle or 750ml wine bottle, with a limit of two bottle per reservation. Please email us at info@restaurantmuku.nyc to confirm whether we carry a label.

name: The Tavern at Gramercy Tavern
description: Revered as one of the country’s great American restaurants, Gramercy Tavern has welcomed guests for over three decades with contemporary seasonal cuisine, warm hospitality, and thoughtful service. Rooted in the rhythms of the harvest and shaped by enduring relationships with local farms and the nearby Union Square Greenmarket, Chef Michael Anthony’s ever-evolving menus unfold across two distinct experiences. The Tavern offers wood-fired, seasonal dishes served à la carte in a lively setting.

name: Potluck Club
description: Potluck Club is a Cantonese-American restaurant founded by childhood friends who grew up in Chinatown with a mission of preserving the neighborhood's cultural heritage.Reservations are recommended, walk-ins are welcomedWe have a 10 minute grace period for all reservations.  If we are able to accommodate you in the event that you arrive beyond the grace period, we will happily do so, however this is at the discretion of the host. If you are running late, please reply to your confirmation text to let us knowTo ensure a smooth dining experience for all our guests, we kindly ask for your understanding regarding our table usage time limits.  Please review and agree to the following guidelines before your visit1-2 guests: 75 mins3-5 guests: 90 mins6+ guests: 2 hoursParties 8+, please e-mail us events@potluckclubny.com to book your Prix Fixe menu reservationCancellation fee of $10 per guest will be applied for any cancellations within 24 hours of the reservation time, & no show

name: Sunn's
description: Sunn’s is a cozy place for banchan and wine in Chinatown. Chef-owner Sunny Lee offers a selection of banchan alongside a rotating menu meant to be shared. Soju, makgeolli and ice cold Korean lagers can be enjoyed alongside the thoughtful wine list overseen by Parcelle.

name: Hawksmoor NYC
description: Located in the heart of Gramercy in the restored Assembly Hall of the landmarked United Charities Building, Hawksmoor is a steak restaurant that celebrates all-natural, pasture-reared, and traditionally dry-aged beef. Our beef is seasoned simply with sea salt and cooked over live-fire charcoal. Our seafood is locally and sustainably sourced from northeastern waters and we use small-farm produce whenever possible. On Sunday afternoons Hawksmoor keeps with the tried-and-true British tradition and features a Sunday Roast. Completing our offerings are award-winning cocktails, including New York City's coldest martini, and a carefully curated wine selection. The restaurant houses 150 in the dining room and 35 in the bar area. There are also two private dining rooms that can hold 12 people and serve exclusive, family-style menus.

name: Estela
description: One of the most celebrated restaurants in the United States, Estela is an intimate downtown bistro from chef Ignacio Mattos that can be experienced in many ways, whether it’s a thrilling dinner in the dining room, a leisurely weekend brunch with friends, or a late-night drink at the bustling bar. Since opening in 2013, the restaurant has served several signature dishes that are now considered New York City classics, while always offering guests something new to try. Estela holds one Michelin star, among many other major accolades.

name: Blu on the Hudson
description: Blu On The Hudson, perched on the Weehawken waterfront, is repeatedly hailed by guests as one of the most spectacular dining experiences in the New York & New Jersey area. Its soaring floor-to-ceiling windows frame uninterrupted, million-dollar views of the Manhattan skyline that many reviewers swear beat anything in the city itself—sunsets and city lights reflecting on the Hudson create pure magic. The sleek, modern 16,000-square-foot space feels upscale yet warm, with a lively bar, live DJ on weekends, and service that’s attentive without being stuffy. Food lovers rave about the inventive contemporary American menu: perfectly cooked steaks, handmade pastas, chilled seafood towers, and truly outstanding sushi. with the freshest options. Cocktails arrive as a mini show—smoke, fire, glowing orbs. Guests call it “romantic perfection,” “a hidden gem,” and “worth every penny and the ferry ride across the river”—an elegant, delicious escape that leaves everyone enchanted.

name: ASKA
description: Chef Fredrik Berselius brings his love of nature to his urban surroundings through food at Brooklyn's only two Michelin-starred restaurant. With an emphasis on ingredients from the Northeastern region and influenced by his Scandinavian homeland, Aska, Swedish for "ashes," offers a distinctive dining experience through a procession of courses prepared from an open kitchen and served to guests of only ten tables each night.

name: Altro Paradiso
description: From globally acclaimed chef Ignacio Mattos, Altro Paradiso is an Italian restaurant in the heart of SoHo and an essential New York City dining destination. The restaurant’s menu draws inspiration from several Italian regions, celebrating timeless craftsmanship throughout, while the room’s high ceilings and glimmering brass bar contribute to a lively nightly atmosphere. Since opening in 2016, Altro has garnered many devoted regulars, ranging from neighborhood residents to travelers who treat the restaurant like a second home whenever they’re in town.

name: Casa Mono
description: Casa Mono and its sister restaurant, Bar Jamon, are located next to each other on Irving Place and 17th Street, just east of Union Square. Awarded three stars from The New York Times in 2015 and a Michelin Star in 2009 (and every year since), Casa Mono is a tapas bar restaurant inspired by the cooking of Spain’s Costa Brava.***Keeping our guests and staff safe is our number one priority.We are strictly following CDC, OSHA and NYC Health Department guidelines.***

name: Joseph Leonard
description:
In its bright and airy modern bistro, Joseph Leonard serves modern American fare with a rustic twist. Appetizers include a charcuterie board with meats and cheeses, caramelized cauliflower with mustard vinaigrette and grilled asparagus with shrimp. Popular entrée items, such as the roasted chicken with English peas, steamed mussels topped with bacon in a white wine sauce and hen of the woods mushrooms with potato gnocchi, speak to the variety and high-quality ingredients utilized at Joseph Leonard. In addition to typical items like strawberry shortcake and chocolate mousse cake, a gourmet selection of cheeses are on the dessert menu.

Craft beer and specialty cocktails add to the contemporary feel of Joseph Leonard. Try the gentleman caller, with bourbon, peach tea, lemon and honey for a cool and refreshing addition to your meal.

name: Tolo
description: Tolo is a restaurant by Ron Yan, a Chinese chef that has spent the past decade working in NYC’s culinary scene. Tolo’s menu features a range of dishes from raw seafood to rice and noodles to sweet & sour crispy fish amidst vintage furniture and the backdrop of the open kitchen. Since then, it has earned recognition from Esquire’s Best New Restaurants in America, The Infatuation’s Best New Restaurants in NYC, and the Michelin Guide.The wide-ranging wine list with over 300 selections is curated by Parcelle. It spotlights natural producers as well as a deep bench of traditional collectibles. The contact phone number is TEXT ONLY. All large parties of 7 - 16 people are subject to the prix-fixe menu.

name: Jeffrey's Grocery
description: Of all Gabriel Stulman's spots, Jeffrey's Grocery is the one you go to snack on raw bar offerings and indulge in a buttery, lobster roll. As with all Stulman joints — the vibe is lively, the service is delightfully friendly, and the specials are very worth considering. It's a go-to spot for a casual, fun-filled evening, particularly if you're in the mood for oysters, which they source from dozens of local aqua-farmers.

name: Fairfax
description: Birds, Burgers and Booze. "We've Got it All"Fairfax is an all-day neighborhood restaurant. Come through and hang!

name: Demo
description: Demo is a restaurant in the West Village serving modern, Europe-inspired cuisine from Executive Chef Quang Nguyen and Sous Chef Dina Fan. Inventive seasonal dishes—like wax beans with bottarga and boquerones—share the menu with updated classics like beef tongue tonnato, alongside a carefully curated list of wines by glass and bottle. The sleek interior, tastefully adorned with red marble and dark wood, hosts a front bar for walk-ins as well as a chef's counter in the back.Please note: We are a small restaurant. Reservations in the dining room and at the chef's counter are intended for dinner. For drinks and snacks we accept walk-ins at the front bar. Thank you for your understanding.

name: The Modern
description: The Modern is a two Michelin-starred contemporary American restaurant located within the MoMA, overlooking the Abby Aldrich Rockefeller Sculpture Garden. The Modern’s seasonal tasting menus, curated by Executive Chef Thomas Allan, are complemented by an award-winning bar and wine program.Part of Danny Meyer’s Union Square Hospitality Group and a member of Relais & Châteaux.

name: Momofuku Noodle Bar - East Village
description: Momofuku Noodle Bar East Village serves a constantly changing roster of noodles, steamed breads, and daily dishes. We offer reservations and also accept walk-ins. Reservations open 14 days in advance at 10 am. Make sure to keep an eye on our website for today's menu. Noodle Bar offers three large format meals:Fried Chicken Meal: Two whole fried chickens (southern-style and Korean-style) served with scallion pancakes, vegetables and sauces. Available for parties of 4 to 6 people at lunch & dinner. Look for "Fried Chicken" when reserving. Fried Chicken & Caviar: Two chickens battered and fried whole, served with caviar, chive crepes, potato chips and sauces. Available for parties of 2 to 4 people at 5pm and 8pm. Look for "Caviar/Chicken" when reserving. Whole Suckling Pig: Whole suckling pig platter with ssäm fixings, sausage & bean stew, rice and steamed buns. Available for parties of 6 to 8 people at 5pm everyday. Look for "Suckling Pig" when reserving.

name: The Bar Room at The Modern
description: Located adjacent to The Museum of Modern Art, The Bar Room at The Modern offers Chef Thomas Allan's vividly seasonal contemporary, à la carte cooking, along with an award-winning wine program and carefully curated cocktails, beer, and spirits. Guests have the option of sitting in The Bar Room, the adjacent lounge, or at the vibrant 20-seat marble bar. Walk-ins are accepted in all three areas, and The Bar Room at The Modern welcomes reservations up to 28 days in advance.

name: Parcelle Greenwich Village
description: Parcelle Greenwich Village is a restaurant from Parcelle, an online wine retailer and hospitality group, located at 72 MacDougal St. There is seasonal outdoor dining, a spirits list, full dinner menu, and wine list of over 500 selections.

name: Bar Kabawa
description: While we do offer reservations each night, we save half the room for walk-ins too. Come on by! | Bar Kabawa is a wine and daiquiri bar from Chef Paul Carmichael and Momofuku celebrating the flavors of the Caribbean in the heart of the East Village. Drawing inspiration from Chef Paul's culinary journey, the menu features daiquiris, wines by the glass, and a compact list of patties and raw bar bites. Bar Kabawa is a place to relax, enjoy, and feel at home—whether you're dropping in for a casual drink or gathering with friends.

name: Mitsuru
description: Mitsuru is a neighborhood Japanese restaurant in the West Village. We offer a range of Japanese fare focused on sushi, hand rolls and heartier entrees alongside a big wine list of 500+ bottles. An omakase can be enjoyed at the 8-seat counter, where chef-owner Mitsuru Tamura presides nightly.

name: Restaurant Le B
description: Restaurant Le B is an award-winning fine dining destination in the heart of Greenwich Village, New York City, helmed by acclaimed Chef/Proprietor Angie Mar. Restaurant Le B is one of only eleven restaurants in New York to be awarded Four Stars by Forbes, and has also received Best New Restaurant accolades from Robb Report, Condé Nast, and the Financial Times, with Esquire Magazine naming its bar program among the 50 best in America.Set in a stylish, supper-club setting inspired by over 100 years of Lower Manhattan dining history, Restaurant Le B offers classic French cuisine mined from the history books, executed with modern technique. Chef Mar's hyper-seasonal cuisine focuses on birds and seafood, marrying French flavors with Eastern influences. The iconic Le Burger is a staple, which Vogue dubbed as "the Birkin bag of burgers." As part of the James Beard Award-winning G.O.A.T. Series for MasterClass in 2025.

name: Bar Miller
description: Nestled in an intimate space in the East Village, Bar Miller is the showcase omakase restaurant from the sushi concept Rosella. Just a few blocks away, our 8-seat sushi bar is seated twice nightly for a tasting menu that features local, sustainably-sourced ingredients.Domestic beer, wine, and cider shape a drink program that stays true to our approach to the menu, while the sake list highlights Brooklyn-based breweries and less conventional styles from Japan.Bar Miller happily accommodates solo diners. Please email info@barmiller with your reservation request and we will follow up!

name: Drift Restaurant & Bar
description: Drift Restaurant in Weehawken, NJ serves as a blend of modern flair and coastal charm.  It is elegantly perched on the waterfront, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Manhattan skyline.  Drift's interior is sleek yet cozy, adorned with a nautical-themed de for that evokes a serene oceanic atmosphere.  The menu is a delightful journey through contemporary American cuisine.

name: Brennan's
description: Celebrating 80 years in 2026 • Wine Spectator Grand Award • James Beard Foundation Finalist • The New York Times Top 25 (New Orleans) & Top 50 (U.S.) • Condé Nast Traveler “Best Restaurants in the World.”Welcome to Brennan's, in the heart of the French Quarter! Chef Kris Padalino's menus marry classic Creole traditions with inspired, contemporary influences. Breakfast at Brennan’s is a spirited, indulgent way to begin your day! Bubbles at Brennan's Happy Hour features discounted bottles of premium Champagne. Flaming Bananas Foster, invented at Brennan's, is a timeless New Orleans tradition. Dine in one of 8 glamorous dining rooms, our famously lush courtyard, or our spectacular wine cellar.

name: GW Fins
description: Experience the cuisine that has created Raving Fans of local diners & national & local food critics alike. Executive Chef Mike Nelson ensures the highest quality seafood by flying in products from around the globe & featuring only the best from local waters - both at their seasonal peak. This commitment to freshness & quality are some of the many reasons GW Fins prints its menu daily. We look forward to serving you soon so we may learn what you think.We hope our dress policy is comfortable for all. Coats & ties are not required. Slacks, dress jeans, & dress shorts are great. We require that gentlemen wear a collared shirt. T-shirts, cut off shorts, & athletic wear, including baseball caps, are not permitted. We ask gentlemen to remove their hats in the Dining Room.

name: La Petite Grocery
description: Come dine in this beautifully restored Uptown restaurant on Magazine Street and enjoy James Beard Award Winning Chef Justin Devillier's contemporary Louisiana Cuisine.The La Petite Grocery name pays homage to the history of its home, a building that’s stood for more than a century. The original structure was built in the late 1800s and called the Central Tea, Coffee and Butter Depot. In 1908, a fire devastated the space and it was transformed into a full service grocery store. Later it was most notably a fine foods and butcher shop, VonderHaar’s Fine Foods until 1982. When La Petite Grocery opened in March of 2004, they similarly aspired to provide the neighborhood with exotic teas, locally roasted coffee, and fresh produce. By doing this, we hope to provide a dining experience that evokes nostalgia of old New Orleans. Reservations are preferred.

name: Jewel of the South
description: Borrowing its name from an influential 1850s-vintage bar in the Central Business District, this pub-like tavern  (with courtyard) occupies an old brick Creole cottage in the French Quarter, where well-known local bartender Chris Hannah serves up cocktails both classic and contemporary. London-born chef Philip Whitmarsh runs the kitchen.Accolades include James Beard, World 50 Best, Art of Hospitality, Best Bar South (North America).

name: Dakar NOLA
description: Dakar NOLA is a modern Senegalese tasting menu restaurant inspired by Chef Serigne Mbaye’s childhood memories in Dakar, Senegal.Dinner features a pescatarian tasting menu. We are reservation-only, open Tuesday–Saturday, and the experience lasts approximately 2 hours. Our menu changes frequently and is largely dairy- and gluten-free.Reservations open 21 days in advance, with new dates released daily at 10:00 AM CT.We can accommodate shellfish and peanut allergies if noted when booking, as well as gluten intolerance/allergies. We cannot accommodate allergies to fin fish, soy, shellfish aroma/fumes, allium, or honey. We are unable to accommodate vegan diets or vegetarians who do not eat food prepared with seafood broth.To ensure the flow of service, late arrivals will join the meal at the course currently being served.We can no longer accommodate parties larger than 6 guests in the dining room. For large groups or corporate events, please submit an inquiry to events@dakarnola.com

name: Acamaya
description: Sisters Ana and Lydia Castro invite you to come join them at Acamaya for a tostada and a margarita at the bar with someone special, or to rally all of your friends and order the whole menu at a large communal table! Either way, we are so happy to have you.Acamaya is a contemporary Mexican seafood restaurant that brings design elements and flavors of their old home, Mexico City, to their new home, New Orleans.The New York Times included Acamaya on its 2024 Restaurant List, and in 2025 both Esquire and Bon Appetit named it one of the Best New Restaurants in America.  We look forward to sharing our passion project with you!

name: Restaurant August
description: August is a Contemporary Creole restaurant creating unique dishes with a focus on Louisiana ingredients and inspired by classical training. Located in a historic 19th century French-Creole building in New Orleans’ Central Business District, the main dining room caters to the most unique dining experience.  The interior is rich with original architectural details, gleaming hardwood floors, soaring columns, mahogany paneling and antique mirrors.

name: Manhatta
description: Manhatta is a modern New York restaurant in the heart of downtown, shaped by the pace and energy of the city. The kitchen is helmed by Executive Chef Michele Brogioni, whose ever-evolving menu draws on traditional techniques and global influences. We offer a prix fixe lunch and multi-course dinner in the dining room, each paired with an award-winning wine list. In the bar, an à la carte menu is served daily.

name: Musaafer - New York
description: Musaafer, meaning traveller, is a dining experience set in opulent space showcasing the art and architecture of India. Chef was sent on an ambitious task of traveling all the states of India; gathering stories and experiences along the way and bringing home age-old regional recipes, which have been translated into our eclectic menu, making the journey an integral part of our menu and regional offerings. You will find Musaafer in the heart of TriBeCa, an opulent Indian restaurant with stunning interiors, custom made and shipped from India. Guests are treated to unforgettable Indian cuisine, a world-class wine program and unparalleled hospitality.Please note our policy regarding children dining at Musaafer: our dining room is designed to welcome children over the age of 10

name: l'abeille
description: Nestled on a charming Tribeca cobblestone street corner, l’abeille is an intimate sanctuary where French culinary artistry meets Japanese finesse. With only 48 seats, this hidden gem captivates diners with its seasonal Chef’s Tasting Menu, meticulously crafted by the visionary Chef Mitsunobu Nagae. Drawing on his rich experience from Michelin-starred establishments in Tokyo, Paris, and New York, including a recent tenure as Chef de Cuisine at Shun in Midtown Manhattan, Chef Mitsu curates a symphony of flavors that transcend borders.At l’abeille, guests experience a harmonious blend of French sophistication and Japanese precision. Complementing the exquisite tasting menu is a rotating selection of seasonal a-la-carte dishes, thoughtfully paired with selections from the wine cellar and a captivating cocktail program. Immerse yourself in an unparalleled dining experience at l’abeille, where each dish tells a story and every moment is a celebration of culinary excellence.

name: Potluck Club
description: Potluck Club is a Cantonese-American restaurant founded by childhood friends who grew up in Chinatown with a mission of preserving the neighborhood's cultural heritage.Reservations are recommended, walk-ins are welcomedWe have a 10 minute grace period for all reservations.  If we are able to accommodate you in the event that you arrive beyond the grace period, we will happily do so, however this is at the discretion of the host. If you are running late, please reply to your confirmation text to let us knowTo ensure a smooth dining experience for all our guests, we kindly ask for your understanding regarding our table usage time limits.  Please review and agree to the following guidelines before your visit1-2 guests: 75 mins3-5 guests: 90 mins6+ guests: 2 hoursParties 8+, please e-mail us events@potluckclubny.com to book your Prix Fixe menu reservationCancellation fee of $10 per guest will be applied for any cancellations within 24 hours of the reservation time, & no show

name: Kabawa
description: Kabawa, a deeply personal restaurant from Chef Paul Carmichael and Momofuku, offers a nuanced and distinct perspective on Caribbean cuisine. Built around a set menu with plenty of choices, it’s a place to take your time, enjoy a meal, and discover something new each time you visit.Kabawa’s menu is a three-course, $150 prix fixe experience, exclusive of beverage, tax, and gratuity.  The restaurant is divided between kitchen counter seating, an immersive experience with direct chef service, or more secluded table seating.Structured to showcase the depth and diversity of Caribbean cuisine, our ingredients are thoughtfully procured, fusing local produce from neighborhoods right here in New York with specialty items sourced directly from the Caribbean. Every touch point — from the custom mosaics to the ingredient sourcing to the instrumental music — is intentional, tapping into Chef Paul’s upbringing in Barbados to reflect the vibrant, welcoming spirit of a Caribbean home.

name: Altro Paradiso
description: From globally acclaimed chef Ignacio Mattos, Altro Paradiso is an Italian restaurant in the heart of SoHo and an essential New York City dining destination. The restaurant’s menu draws inspiration from several Italian regions, celebrating timeless craftsmanship throughout, while the room’s high ceilings and glimmering brass bar contribute to a lively nightly atmosphere. Since opening in 2016, Altro has garnered many devoted regulars, ranging from neighborhood residents to travelers who treat the restaurant like a second home whenever they’re in town.

name: San Sabino
description: San Sabino is an Italian-American seafood restaurant from the wife and husband chef team behind Don Angie -- Angie Rito and Scott Tacinelli -- in partnership with Quality Branded.Angie and Scott opened Don Angie in 2018 to tremendous critical acclaim, and quickly became known for boldly unexpected dishes that challenge your perception of traditional Italian-American cooking. Six years later and just a few doors down from Don Angie, they've now opened their second restaurant, San Sabino. Named after Scott’s grandfather (from Sanza, Italy, where most people are named after the patron saint Sabino), San Sabino offers a playful spin on Italian dishes from Shrimp Parm to Pasta Alle Vongole, with bold twists influenced by coastal American cities where many Italians settled, from New Orleans to the Jersey Shore.

name: Sunn's
description: Sunn’s is a cozy place for banchan and wine in Chinatown. Chef-owner Sunny Lee offers a selection of banchan alongside a rotating menu meant to be shared. Soju, makgeolli and ice cold Korean lagers can be enjoyed alongside the thoughtful wine list overseen by Parcelle.

name: Don Angie
description: Don Angie is an intimate restaurant serving up a modern ode to Italian-American cuisine by husband and wife chefs and co-owners Angela Rito and Scott Tacinelli, in partnership with Quality Branded. Located in the heart of New York City’s West Village, the restaurant’s menu reimagines comforting dishes from Angie and Scott’s childhoods, with distinctive twists, often drawing inspiration from their collective travels.  Shortly after opening, Don Angie earned a 2-star critic’s pick review from the New York Times and named one of Esquire’s Best New Restaurants in America in 2018. Scott and Angie earned nominations from the James Beard Foundation in 2019, 2020 2022, and 2025. In May 2021, Don Angie was awarded a Michelin star.

name: Muku
description: Muku (“無垢”), meaning “purity” or “innocence,” is a Japanese restaurant in New York City led by award-winning Chef Manabu Asanuma, whose experience spans acclaimed kitchens in New York, Japan, and Taiwan. Rooted in seasonality, simplicity, and intention, Muku draws inspiration from kaiseki while celebrating "goho" - the five classical techniques of Japanese cooking: raw, grilled, simmered, steamed, and fried. Each dish is crafted with restraint, using only what enhances the true character of the ingredients, resulting in a focused, expressive cuisine that honors tradition while offering a refined, modern Japanese dining experience.Guests are welcome to bring bottles not featured on our beverage list to enjoy with our menu. Corkage is $175 per 720ml sake bottle or 750ml wine bottle, with a limit of two bottle per reservation. Please email us at info@restaurantmuku.nyc to confirm whether we carry a label.

name: Estela
description: One of the most celebrated restaurants in the United States, Estela is an intimate downtown bistro from chef Ignacio Mattos that can be experienced in many ways, whether it’s a thrilling dinner in the dining room, a leisurely weekend brunch with friends, or a late-night drink at the bustling bar. Since opening in 2013, the restaurant has served several signature dishes that are now considered New York City classics, while always offering guests something new to try. Estela holds one Michelin star, among many other major accolades.

name: Scarr's Pizza
description: First opened in 2016 and located on Orchard Street, where the LES, Chinatown and Dimes Square converge, Scarr's Pizza has been called, "The best slice in New York." With a focus on all-natural and organic ingredients, owner and 2024 James Beard Nominee (Best Chef NY State) Scarr Pimentel has crafted not only the best tasting slice in the city, but the healthiest too. Skip the line, book a table and come in for a pie. There is a full bar and the dine-in menu features the crowd favorite Hotboi and Clark Kent as well as exclusive items like the Calzones.

name: Una Pizza Napoletana
description: Reservations open 14 days in advance at 9 AM ET.Chef/Owner Anthony Mangieri has been crafting naturally-leavened, wood-fired pizzas with meticulous attention to detail since 1996. A pioneer of Neapolitan pizza in the U.S., Anthony still makes every ball of dough by hand and is at Una making pizza every night. A few starters and desserts complement the pizzas, along with wines from Campania and Champagne. Everything is made fresh daily until sold out. The choice to have only one location allows for an obsessive focus on every detail.Una has been awarded #1 pizzeria in the world by 50 Top Pizza for 2022, 2024, and 2025, a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand, and recognized in media outlets including the TODAY Show, CBS Mornings, and Esquire. Open Thursday, Friday and Saturday. Reservations from 5:00 - 9:30 for parties of up to four. Reservations that have been traded or purchased through third party platforms will not be honored.

name: Parcelle Chinatown
description: Parcelle Chinatown, located at 135 Division Street, is a great spot for dinner or a casual wine-and-snack hangout, and if you're feeling spontaneous, there's always room for walk-ins.The upstairs main room features vintage furniture and cozy seating. Known for their robust wine list that highlights both classics and unique finds.Downstairs, you'll find their Studio Room, an intimate venue used for private events. When not booked, it transforms into a cocktail bar open to the public Thursday through Saturday.

name: The Dining Room at Gramercy Tavern
description: In the Dining Room, a warm and welcoming setting frames a more refined expression of our seasonal menu. At dinner, the menu is centered around a five-course, prix fixe seasonal experience. At lunch, guests may choose between a three-course prix fixe or à la carte.Revered as one of the country’s great American restaurants, Gramercy Tavern has welcomed guests for over three decades with contemporary seasonal cuisine, warm hospitality, and thoughtful service. Rooted in the rhythms of the harvest and shaped by enduring relationships with local farms and the nearby Union Square Greenmarket, Chef Michael Anthony’s ever-evolving menus unfold across two distinct experiences.

name: The Tavern at Gramercy Tavern
description: Revered as one of the country’s great American restaurants, Gramercy Tavern has welcomed guests for over three decades with contemporary seasonal cuisine, warm hospitality, and thoughtful service. Rooted in the rhythms of the harvest and shaped by enduring relationships with local farms and the nearby Union Square Greenmarket, Chef Michael Anthony’s ever-evolving menus unfold across two distinct experiences. The Tavern offers wood-fired, seasonal dishes served à la carte in a lively setting.

name: Union Square Cafe
description: Founded in 1985, Union Square Cafe pioneered a new way of dining, drawing inspiration from the Union Square Greenmarket and showcasing the best local ingredients in a casual and contemporary dining room characterized by warmth and hospitality. Having trained and mentored scores of restaurant professionals for over three decades, Union Square Cafe is the birthplace of a generation of renowned restaurants, chefs, and restaurateurs.The restaurant has won five James Beard Awards and ranked in first place on Zagat Survey’s Most Popular Restaurant list an unprecedented nine times.

name: Demo
description: Demo is a restaurant in the West Village serving modern, Europe-inspired cuisine from Executive Chef Quang Nguyen and Sous Chef Dina Fan. Inventive seasonal dishes—like wax beans with bottarga and boquerones—share the menu with updated classics like beef tongue tonnato, alongside a carefully curated list of wines by glass and bottle. The sleek interior, tastefully adorned with red marble and dark wood, hosts a front bar for walk-ins as well as a chef's counter in the back.Please note: We are a small restaurant. Reservations in the dining room and at the chef's counter are intended for dinner. For drinks and snacks we accept walk-ins at the front bar. Thank you for your understanding.

name: Joseph Leonard
description:
In its bright and airy modern bistro, Joseph Leonard serves modern American fare with a rustic twist. Appetizers include a charcuterie board with meats and cheeses, caramelized cauliflower with mustard vinaigrette and grilled asparagus with shrimp. Popular entrée items, such as the roasted chicken with English peas, steamed mussels topped with bacon in a white wine sauce and hen of the woods mushrooms with potato gnocchi, speak to the variety and high-quality ingredients utilized at Joseph Leonard. In addition to typical items like strawberry shortcake and chocolate mousse cake, a gourmet selection of cheeses are on the dessert menu.

Craft beer and specialty cocktails add to the contemporary feel of Joseph Leonard. Try the gentleman caller, with bourbon, peach tea, lemon and honey for a cool and refreshing addition to your meal.

name: Jeffrey's Grocery
description: Of all Gabriel Stulman's spots, Jeffrey's Grocery is the one you go to snack on raw bar offerings and indulge in a buttery, lobster roll. As with all Stulman joints — the vibe is lively, the service is delightfully friendly, and the specials are very worth considering. It's a go-to spot for a casual, fun-filled evening, particularly if you're in the mood for oysters, which they source from dozens of local aqua-farmers.

name: Red Hook Tavern
description: Red Hook Tavern brings classic American tavern fare to the waterfront village in Brooklyn, where friends can share a bottle of wine, a few laughs, and a great meal. We hope from the moment you walk into this beautiful old space it makes you feel as special as it did the first time I walked in, almost five years ago. Cheers, Billy

name: Fairfax
description: Birds, Burgers and Booze. "We've Got it All"Fairfax is an all-day neighborhood restaurant. Come through and hang!

name: Ci Siamo
description: Ci Siamo translates to "here we are" or "we've finally arrived." It's the clinking of glasses after a long week, the rush of arriving at a new destination, the relief of a familiar smile — it's an exhalation. Celebrating the beauty of simplicity, Chef Hillary Sterling centers her Italian-inflected menu around live-fire cooking and seasonal ingredients, bridging the traditional with the contemporary in a transportive yet familiar space.

name: Casa Mono
description: Casa Mono and its sister restaurant, Bar Jamon, are located next to each other on Irving Place and 17th Street, just east of Union Square. Awarded three stars from The New York Times in 2015 and a Michelin Star in 2009 (and every year since), Casa Mono is a tapas bar restaurant inspired by the cooking of Spain’s Costa Brava.***Keeping our guests and staff safe is our number one priority.We are strictly following CDC, OSHA and NYC Health Department guidelines.***

name: Tolo
description: Tolo is a restaurant by Ron Yan, a Chinese chef that has spent the past decade working in NYC’s culinary scene. Tolo’s menu features a range of dishes from raw seafood to rice and noodles to sweet & sour crispy fish amidst vintage furniture and the backdrop of the open kitchen. Since then, it has earned recognition from Esquire’s Best New Restaurants in America, The Infatuation’s Best New Restaurants in NYC, and the Michelin Guide.The wide-ranging wine list with over 300 selections is curated by Parcelle. It spotlights natural producers as well as a deep bench of traditional collectibles. The contact phone number is TEXT ONLY. All large parties of 7 - 16 people are subject to the prix-fixe menu.

name: SAPPEISAN
description: SAPPE is a trip to explore something unique, authentic and ethereal. Our guest will be indulged and pampered through all their five perceptions; visual, auditory, olfactory, haptic and gustatory. SAPPE is the extraordinary place where people come to rejoice and revel. The train market and street food style are what SAPPE aim to offer. The vibe of bustling ambience of train station, the food stalls that offer street bites ‘ปิ้งย่าง (Ping-Yang)’ which is variety of grilled goodies on bamboo skewers and BBQ, as well as the bold flavor of E-San style cuisine are what SAPPE is looking to introduce.

name: Hawksmoor NYC
description: Located in the heart of Gramercy in the restored Assembly Hall of the landmarked United Charities Building, Hawksmoor is a steak restaurant that celebrates all-natural, pasture-reared, and traditionally dry-aged beef. Our beef is seasoned simply with sea salt and cooked over live-fire charcoal. Our seafood is locally and sustainably sourced from northeastern waters and we use small-farm produce whenever possible. On Sunday afternoons Hawksmoor keeps with the tried-and-true British tradition and features a Sunday Roast. Completing our offerings are award-winning cocktails, including New York City's coldest martini, and a carefully curated wine selection. The restaurant houses 150 in the dining room and 35 in the bar area. There are also two private dining rooms that can hold 12 people and serve exclusive, family-style menus.

name: Sailor
description: Sailor is a neighborhood bistro celebrating Chef April Bloomfield’s menu of elevated takes on familiar dishes. At the heart of the restaurants is it's deep wine list, which ranges from easy drinkers through classics and more esoteric selections. Tying it all together is the thoughtful service that Happy Cooking Hospitality has become known for.

name: Momofuku Noodle Bar - Uptown
description: At this second location, David Chang rethinks his iconic noodle shop. The Columbus Circle Noodle Bar serves a constantly changing roster of noodles, steamed breads made in-house, soft serve, and daily dishes, in a sleek wood-accented space. Bar-wise, there’s a full selection of beer, wine, sake, and cocktails, with a focus on highballs. Stop by for a quick bite at the kitchen counter, or book the private dining room for a celebratory event.Noodle Bar Uptown accepts reservations 30 days in advance starting at 10 am. Although making a reservation is recommended, walk-ins are welcome and can be accommodated at the bar or at tables if space permits.For parties larger than 9 guests, please visit the Private Events page on our website.

name: Momofuku Noodle Bar - East Village
description: Momofuku Noodle Bar East Village serves a constantly changing roster of noodles, steamed breads, and daily dishes. We offer reservations and also accept walk-ins. Reservations open 14 days in advance at 10 am. Make sure to keep an eye on our website for today's menu. Noodle Bar offers three large format meals:Fried Chicken Meal: Two whole fried chickens (southern-style and Korean-style) served with scallion pancakes, vegetables and sauces. Available for parties of 4 to 6 people at lunch & dinner. Look for "Fried Chicken" when reserving. Fried Chicken & Caviar: Two chickens battered and fried whole, served with caviar, chive crepes, potato chips and sauces. Available for parties of 2 to 4 people at 5pm and 8pm. Look for "Caviar/Chicken" when reserving. Whole Suckling Pig: Whole suckling pig platter with ssäm fixings, sausage & bean stew, rice and steamed buns. Available for parties of 6 to 8 people at 5pm everyday. Look for "Suckling Pig" when reserving.

name: Parcelle Greenwich Village
description: Parcelle Greenwich Village is a restaurant from Parcelle, an online wine retailer and hospitality group, located at 72 MacDougal St. There is seasonal outdoor dining, a spirits list, full dinner menu, and wine list of over 500 selections.

name: Razza - Jersey City
description: Razza is an intimate pizzeria  in Jersey City, NJ centered around wood-fired pizzas made with locally sourced ingredients. Chef and owner Dan Richer, a six-time James Beard Award–nominated chef, is known for challenging conventional pizza-making practices with the goal of elevating the craft of pizza in America. The restaurant offers seasonally driven small plates, housemade bread and butter and a thoughtfully curated bar program. The only pizzeria to receive a three-star review from The New York Times, Razza was named Best Pizza in North America by 50 Top Pizza in 2019. The restaurant and Chef Dan Richer have been featured on Somebody Feed Phil, CBS Saturday morning and CNN’s Breaking Bread. Reservations are available 28 days in advance at noon.

name: Bar Kabawa
description: While we do offer reservations each night, we save half the room for walk-ins too. Come on by! | Bar Kabawa is a wine and daiquiri bar from Chef Paul Carmichael and Momofuku celebrating the flavors of the Caribbean in the heart of the East Village. Drawing inspiration from Chef Paul's culinary journey, the menu features daiquiris, wines by the glass, and a compact list of patties and raw bar bites. Bar Kabawa is a place to relax, enjoy, and feel at home—whether you're dropping in for a casual drink or gathering with friends.

name: Mitsuru
description: Mitsuru is a neighborhood Japanese restaurant in the West Village. We offer a range of Japanese fare focused on sushi, hand rolls and heartier entrees alongside a big wine list of 500+ bottles. An omakase can be enjoyed at the 8-seat counter, where chef-owner Mitsuru Tamura presides nightly.

name: Maddy Rose at Liberty House
description: Where bold flavors meet unbeatable waterfront city views. Whether you’re diving into our perfectly seared steaks, ultra-fresh seafood, or signature craft cocktails, every bite (and sip) is a vibe. We offer a menu that speaks to every palate.You may remember us as Liberty House, and rest assured, we are still the same mouthwatering food and cocktails, unmatched level of hospitality, and unbeatable skyline waterfront views, we just decided to rename the restaurant after our daughter, Maddy Rose.Located on the Jersey City waterfront, Maddy Rose Restaurant offers a dining experience like no other. With panoramic views of the New York City skyline, indulge in expertly prepared steaks, fresh seafood, and elevated yet approachable cuisine that brings bold flavors to every plate. Whether you're joining us for a romantic dinner, a lively night out, or cocktails by the water, our restaurant is designed to impress.

name: Restaurant Le B
description: Restaurant Le B is an award-winning fine dining destination in the heart of Greenwich Village, New York City, helmed by acclaimed Chef/Proprietor Angie Mar. Restaurant Le B is one of only eleven restaurants in New York to be awarded Four Stars by Forbes, and has also received Best New Restaurant accolades from Robb Report, Condé Nast, and the Financial Times, with Esquire Magazine naming its bar program among the 50 best in America.Set in a stylish, supper-club setting inspired by over 100 years of Lower Manhattan dining history, Restaurant Le B offers classic French cuisine mined from the history books, executed with modern technique. Chef Mar's hyper-seasonal cuisine focuses on birds and seafood, marrying French flavors with Eastern influences. The iconic Le Burger is a staple, which Vogue dubbed as "the Birkin bag of burgers." As part of the James Beard Award-winning G.O.A.T. Series for MasterClass in 2025.

name: The Modern
description: The Modern is a two Michelin-starred contemporary American restaurant located within the MoMA, overlooking the Abby Aldrich Rockefeller Sculpture Garden. The Modern’s seasonal tasting menus, curated by Executive Chef Thomas Allan, are complemented by an award-winning bar and wine program.Part of Danny Meyer’s Union Square Hospitality Group and a member of Relais & Châteaux.

name: Blu on the Hudson
description: Blu On The Hudson, perched on the Weehawken waterfront, is repeatedly hailed by guests as one of the most spectacular dining experiences in the New York & New Jersey area. Its soaring floor-to-ceiling windows frame uninterrupted, million-dollar views of the Manhattan skyline that many reviewers swear beat anything in the city itself—sunsets and city lights reflecting on the Hudson create pure magic. The sleek, modern 16,000-square-foot space feels upscale yet warm, with a lively bar, live DJ on weekends, and service that’s attentive without being stuffy. Food lovers rave about the inventive contemporary American menu: perfectly cooked steaks, handmade pastas, chilled seafood towers, and truly outstanding sushi. with the freshest options. Cocktails arrive as a mini show—smoke, fire, glowing orbs. Guests call it “romantic perfection,” “a hidden gem,” and “worth every penny and the ferry ride across the river”—an elegant, delicious escape that leaves everyone enchanted.

name: The Bar Room at The Modern
description: Located adjacent to The Museum of Modern Art, The Bar Room at The Modern offers Chef Thomas Allan's vividly seasonal contemporary, à la carte cooking, along with an award-winning wine program and carefully curated cocktails, beer, and spirits. Guests have the option of sitting in The Bar Room, the adjacent lounge, or at the vibrant 20-seat marble bar. Walk-ins are accepted in all three areas, and The Bar Room at The Modern welcomes reservations up to 28 days in advance.

name: ASKA
description: Chef Fredrik Berselius brings his love of nature to his urban surroundings through food at Brooklyn's only two Michelin-starred restaurant. With an emphasis on ingredients from the Northeastern region and influenced by his Scandinavian homeland, Aska, Swedish for "ashes," offers a distinctive dining experience through a procession of courses prepared from an open kitchen and served to guests of only ten tables each night.

name: Tavern Next Door
description: I've been dreaming of creating a cocktail bar for years now and proud to say today it becomes a reality. Based on one crazy night in Paris many years ago Tavern Next Door comes to life. My brother Conor Johns leads the way with reinvented disco era cocktails that are sublime. Some fun snacks and yes we will have a version of the Burger there as well. Please come hang in this dreamy lounge that we already love so much.

name: Bar Miller
description: Nestled in an intimate space in the East Village, Bar Miller is the showcase omakase restaurant from the sushi concept Rosella. Just a few blocks away, our 8-seat sushi bar is seated twice nightly for a tasting menu that features local, sustainably-sourced ingredients.Domestic beer, wine, and cider shape a drink program that stays true to our approach to the menu, while the sake list highlights Brooklyn-based breweries and less conventional styles from Japan.Bar Miller happily accommodates solo diners. Please email info@barmiller with your reservation request and we will follow up!

name: Felina Steak- Jersey City
description: Located directly on the Hudson River, Felina Steak is a sleek, modern shrine to Italian-inspired steaks, chops, and seafood. The entrance showcases a dry-aging room with prime cuts and a two-tiered live lobster tank. Inside, an open kitchen adds energy to the intimate dining room, where guests enjoy views of the Manhattan skyline and the Statue of Liberty while watching the culinary team work with focus and precision. The menu is globally inspired yet rooted in bold, flavor-driven dishes that highlight high-quality ingredients and thoughtful techniques. Guests can sip expertly crafted cocktails at our bar, Nove, or explore our curated wine list with help from our sommelier. Whether you're here for a night out or a special occasion, Felina Steak delivers a unique and elevated experience. Outdoor dining is now available on a first come, first served basis, weather permitting. Be sure to visit the Stork Club Rooftop after dinner for more cocktails and breathtaking views.

name: Drift Restaurant & Bar
description: Drift Restaurant in Weehawken, NJ serves as a blend of modern flair and coastal charm.  It is elegantly perched on the waterfront, offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Manhattan skyline.  Drift's interior is sleek yet cozy, adorned with a nautical-themed de for that evokes a serene oceanic atmosphere.  The menu is a delightful journey through contemporary American cuisine.

name: AVA MediterrAegean Winter Park
description: AVA MediterrAegean is a modern Greek Agora, a multi-sensory transporting venue bringing dining experience and pleasure together in a refined and spirited atmosphere.Meaning life, water, island, bird in Greek, AVA is a celebration of splendor, freedom, escapism and joy, where genuine hospitality, delectable food and vibrant atmosphere combine to entertain the senses and transport guests to celebrate the night away.Deeply rooted in the Mediterranean,  AVA lives by its mantra “PAREA”, from Greek, meaning a group of friends, who gather to share life experiences, philosophies, values and ideas.Lunch | Brunch | Dinner.

name: The Pinery
description: The Pinery is a guest-driven, chef-inspired dining experience located on beautiful Lake Ivanhoe, in the heart of Orlando. Inhabiting land that once cultivated Florida’s former top export crop -pineapples- The Pinery celebrates Florida’s forgotten history while offering guests a charming blend of rustic elegance, industrial comfort, and serene lake views. Join us in Ivanhoe Village, take in the sunset by the lake, celebrate your friends and enjoy the beauty and bounty Orlando has to offer.

name: Norman's - Orlando
description: Norman's Florida Kitchen is the Orlando dining experience featuring the cuisine of James Beard awarded Chef and author, Norman Van Aken. Norman’s focuses on providing warm hospitality with a sophisticated ambiance, while serving the highest quality steaks and freshest Florida seafood, paired with an award-winning wine list and artisanal craft cocktails. Several dining spaces are available including the main dining room, two private dining rooms, an intimate bar/lounge, and an elegant covered open-air terrace for elevated dining.Multiple award-wins include ‘Best Restaurant’ and ‘Best Date Night Restaurant’.Located just minutes from the Orange County Convention Center and other major Orlando attractions, it’s the perfect place to enjoy a memorable evening.HAPPY HOUR: Daily 5-7pm with $10 Cocktails, $8 Wines by the glass, and $5 BeersDRESS CODE: Dining Room: Smart Casual/ Smart Dress (jackets are not required) Terrace: Resort Casual/ No baseball caps, gym apparel, tank tops

name: Friday Saturday Sunday
description: New American with a familiar name. Chef Chad Williams and his wife Hanna have taken a familiar spot and reinvented it.  Craft cocktails at the main floor bar and delicious and inventive dishes in the second floor dining room. Please be aware that we do not have an elevator. For diners with limited mobility we offer the full dinner menu at the bar, and seating is first come first served. Reservations for the entire month open on the first of the month prior at 10am via OpenTable.Please email with any questions, as our phone line is information only.

name: a.kitchen
description: Located at 18th and Walnut, a.kitchen is a French inspired American restaurant rooted in seasonality and a deep love of wine. Led by Executive Chef Eli Collins, the menu moves from thoughtful small plates to refined lunch and dinner classics, all designed to pair beautifully with what is in your glass. Morning service features a seasonal breakfast, with weekend brunch offering a fresh take on daytime favorites.​Nationally recognized for its natural and terroir focused wine program, a.kitchen highlights iconic regions and emerging producers, with a knowledgeable team ready to guide your next pour. The bar offers a focused cocktail list and wines by the glass, making it ideal for a drink before dinner or a casual seat at the bar.​ In warmer months, enjoy sidewalk café dining with a relaxed European feel. Honored by Wine Spectator, The New York Times, Vogue, and the James Beard Foundation.

name: Pine Street Grill
description: Pine Street Grill is a neighborhood restaurant serving timeless American food made with care. Located on a corner of Fitler Square, Pine Street offers thoughtfully prepared classics such as matzah ball soup, spinach artichoke dip, Greek salad, and rotisserie chicken.Our approach is simple: the same sourcing and care found at My Loup and Her Place Supper Club, with a focus on the core fundamentals that make food and drink memorable. Our beverage program carries this forward with classic cocktails, beer on tap (including birch!), and a tightly curated wine program with no pretense, just great drinkability at a variety of price points. Half of our dining room is available to reserve and the other half saved for walk-ins. Reservations open 30 days in advance at 9am ET daily. Happy hour is from 4 - 6pm daily and we also offer a PSG late night burger + beer special (draft beer + PSG burger for $20) nightly.

name: Her Place Supper Club
description: September reservations available Sunday, 8/16 @ 6pm ET. We are fully committed for August reservations. Please add your name to Notify Me for any openings.Liguria Wine Dinner reservations are available Wednesday, 8/26 at 12pm ET.Her Place is kind of like a restaurant but kind of like a dinner party. The menu changes triweekly, sometimes daily, sometimes a la minute. Imagine showing up to your mom's friend's house for dinner and just eating whatever she makes -- it's a little like that. The food leans French and Italian with some Jewish touches swirled in. We offer two seatings of 26 guests Monday - Friday, at 6pm and 8:30pm. Our maximum reservation is for 6 guests. We have wine and cocktails!!

name: My Loup
description: Located just off Rittenhouse Square, My Loup’s menu is French Canadian with a lighter touch. Guests can fashion a meal from a selection of smaller dishes and a drink at the bar or commit to a giant plateau fruits de mer and anything else the kitchen decides to send out as part of their “Let Us Cook For You” menu — potentially a half chicken with matzah balls or a halibut tail with turnips, smoked butter, and clams. Executive Chef Alex Kemp works with what suppliers have fresh, with change viewed as a catalyst that propels the menu forward and fosters a dynamic energy that encourages experimentation.

name: Honeysuckle
description: Honeysuckle is more than a restaurant. It is a network of community spaces centered around ancestry, nourishment, and reclamation, founded by two-time James Beard Award Finalists Chef Omar Tate and Chef Cybille St.Aude-Tate. Located in Philadelphia’s North Broad neighborhood, our Michelin Guide recommended space offers a fresh perspective on food systems—expanding Afrocentricity in food by celebrating the legacies, recipes, and traditions that came before us.Our multi-course tasting menu in the main dining room highlights local Black farmers, Indigenous ingredients, and the diverse foodways and cultures that shape our work. Our à la carte menu is available exclusively in our bar and lounge.Our lunch program extends our commitment to community through accessibility, flavor, and hospitality. Join us from 11am to 2:30pm Wednesday to Friday for a three-course experience offered at a price of your choosing.

name: Mawn
description: Mawn is open 4 days a week and is a 28 seat BYOB in the heart of South Philadelphia's iconic Italian Market.  Receiving national recognition, Chef Phila was the recipient of a James Beard Award for Emerging Chef in 2025, one of Food & Wine's Best New Chefs Class of 2025 and named on the 25 Best restaurants in America list for The New York Times. Reservations are released on the 1st of each month at 12PM NOON for the following month.**** Please note they will book VERY FAST and not all trying at the release will be able to get through. This is due to the HIGH demand and VERY limited availability.If there is nothing showing on OpenTable, it does mean all available reservations are gone. USE the NOTIFY option to receive alerts as people cancel. There is no internal Waitlist. ****Mawn offers WALK IN ONLY Lunch Thursday- Saturday 11am-2:30 (2:15 last seating) Dinner Dishes are offered as additions daily. Lunch is a great way to experience Mawn if you cannot get a reservation.

name: Vetri Cucina - Philadelphia
description: *Reservations are released on the first of the month for the following month: ie. On October 1st, reservations are released for the month of November at 11 am ESTLocated in a historic townhome in the heart of Philadelphia, Vetri Cucina is a unique space that invites guests to become part of our family. The intimate dining rooms evoke the charms of Italy with custom crafted features including hand-blown Murano glass chandeliers, Richard Ginori porcelain and Venetian glassware.Showcasing the constantly evolving, dynamic creativity of Chef Vetri and his team, Vetri Cucina serves a classic tasting menu at $165pp using the highest quality local and specialty ingredients. Vetri Cucina also offers a seasonal Forchetta menu which is a premium tasting menu experience at $215pp. These are the restaurant’s sole dining options, designed to provide each guest with a memorable, unparalleled experience.

name: Sao
description: Sao is the second restaurant from James Beard Award Winning Chef Phila Lorn and wife Rachel Lorn: A Southeast Asian oyster and crudo bar in the heart of South Philly.We are open Wednesday through Saturday. Our maximum party size is 4 people, due to the size and configuration of the dining room. If you’re unable to secure a reservation on the day you're looking for, we would encourage you to use OpenTable’s notification feature to set alerts for cancellations. We also hold a few seats for walk-in parties of 4 or less. We tend to fill those up right at 5pm (often there's a line by 4:30), and then take names at the door for the next round of walk ins.

name: Emmett
description: Welcome to Emmett! We're a Philadelphia restaurant blending Levantine cuisine with elements from around the greater Mediterranean, highlighting French, Italian, North African, and Middle Eastern flavors.  We strive to emphasize local connections, sourcing from a range of local farms to supply our kitchen as well as showcasing Philly artists for ceramics, glassware, and design, with the goal of cultivating community relationships and staying true to the city of Philadelphia. ​Chef Partner Evan Snyder leads the culinary team, while Managing Partner Julian van der Tak oversees operations.

name: Provenance
description: Join us for a modern approach to classic French food with a subtle Korean influence through an extensive, seafood-focused tasting menu by Nicholas Bazik!Provenance is a reference to our dedication to sourcing the best, high-quality ingredients while also partnering with like-minded local purveyors, farmers, and artisans. We are a non-tipping restaurant, so a 20% service charge is added automatically to your bill. This ensures that our staff is paid a fair wage.If there are any allergies, please let us know as soon as possible, so our kitchen can try to make necessary adjustments. Please note that our kitchen may not be able to accommodate any undisclosed or unconfirmed allergies.If you arrive more than 15 minutes after your reservation time, you will miss part of the tasting menu.

name: Tabachoy
description: Tabachoy is a Tagalog nickname given to a friend or family member; it means chubby or fatty. We know it sounds mean, but Filipinos give each other inappropriately appropriate nicknames all the time. Your baby brother’s got some neck rolls? Tabachoy. Auntie’s six months pregnant? Tabachoy. Or your dad’s got a six pack, but just finished his third piece of bibingka? Tabachoy!We cook the food that got us made fun of in elementary school, when we opened our country crock “Tupperware” - the food that reminds us of home. We don't strive to make a better adobo than your mothers, but we do want to share ours with you.

name: Pietramala
description: Pietramala is a little restaurant located in Northern Liberties celebrating plants, wood-fire cooking and seasonality. We offer a small, regularly changing menu based on the highest quality, organic ingredients grown or made with care in Pennsylvania and the Mid-Atlantic. Our Italian leaning, but globally inspired food is always presented simply with familiar flavors achieved in creative new ways. Often touched by fire, smoke or fermentation to unlock unique flavors, our dishes sometimes require days or even months of preparation. We pride ourselves on our open kitchen, where our wood-fired hearth takes center stage, and our commitment to friendly service and warm hospitality in an intimate, but lively atmosphere. All are welcome and our entirely plant-based menu can accommodate any allergy or dietary restriction with advance notice. We look forward to welcoming you.

name: Almanac
description: Almanac is a secluded haven where precision meets passion. Inspired by the finest traditions of Japanese bar craft and the mystique of the American speakeasy, we offer an intimate setting for slow, intentional drinking. Our handcrafted cocktails—guided by the Slow Drinks movement—explore the meeting point of Japanese flavors and American terroir, creating experiences that are both timeless and distinctly of this place.Reservations must be confirmed via OpenTable or SMS to be held. This helps us accommodate walk-ins and avoid unnecessary cancellation fees. Unconfirmed reservations may be released to our waitlist. Late cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows are subject to a $20 per person fee.House Rules: - All guests must be 21+. Valid ID required.- No parties >4, No split parties.- No seating incomplete parties.- Your stay may be limited to 2hrs.- Flash photos, lights, phone calls strictly prohibited.- No rowdy behavior. - Be mindful of fellow guests in the building.

name: Ogawa Sushi & Kappo Omakase
description: Experience an unforgettable journey through the artistry of Edomae sushi at Ogawa Sushi & Kappo, an intimate omakase restaurant in Old City, Philadelphia. Led by Head Chef Carlos Wills, each 23-course omakase dinner features highlights such as buttery Ōtoro, sweet Bafun Uni from Hokkaido, delicate Kinmedai, and our signature Homeyaki Ebi Tamago. Every piece reflects precise Edo-style techniques and balance, with fish flown directly from Tokyo’s Toyosu Market. Guided by Master Chef Minoru Ogawa, who travels to Japan monthly to source the finest seafood, Ogawa delivers one of Philadelphia’s most refined Japanese dining experiences. Elevate your meal with expert sake pairings, or explore our collection of Japanese whisky, craft beer, and premium sake. Discover why Ogawa is acclaimed as one of the best omakase in Philadelphia, where craftsmanship, tradition, and hospitality unite.

name: The Mission – Old Town Scottsdale
description: Old Town Scottsdale’s heart beats to a Latin drum at The Mission where renowned Chef Matt Carter (Zinc Bistro and Fat Ox) brings a modern twist to Latin cuisine blending influences from Spain, Mexico, Central America and South America. Sip a signature margarita with unique flavors such as cucumber jalepeno or aguacate (yes, we said avocado) as you watch your Tableside Guacamole made to your taste from more than a dozen fresh ingredients. Home made tortillas, and salsas are made fresh daily to accompany an assortment of meats and seafood  prepared on a Plancha or a grill using pecan and mesquite wood that instills a rich flavor.  And save room for dessert including our pumpkin bread pudding or expresso churros.

name: Fat Ox
description: Inspired by the rich culinary history of the Bue Grasso (fat ox) Festival of Carrù Italy, Fat Ox serves modern interpretations of traditional Italian dishes from acclaimed local Chef /owner Matt Carter.The sleek 7,000 sq/ft restaurant features hand made pastas crafted in house daily, slow-roasted meats and seafood, an international wine list and a full craft cocktail bar to make for a truly special experience.The newly renovated front patio and our beautiful courtyard patio are the perfect place to enjoy the fall weather.

name: Élephante Scottsdale
description: From Nick Mathers' Wish You Were Here Group, Élephante Scottsdale channels the spirit and cuisine of coastal southern Italy. Inspired by travels to Pantelleria and the Aeolian Islands, Élephante transports guests to the Italian Coast through thoughtfully designed spaces and seasonal menus.NOTE: For group reservations of 8-12 guests, we offer family style dining with a pre-fixe menu. To book a group reservation, please email info@elephanteaz.com.Parties of 13+ are considered event bookings. For event bookings, private & semi-private event inquiries, please email events@elephanteaz.com.

name: Filthy Animal
description: From the Pretty Decent Concepts team comes Filthy Animal.  Elegant and wild, this concept is inspired by the beauty and brutality of the jungle. Featuring a wood fire cooking pit as the focal point of the restaurant, this concept is delivering a dining experience like no other in Arizona.

name: Cleaverman
description: Cleaverman brings grand steakhouse dining to Downtown Phoenix at Arizona Center, steps from Footprint Center and Chase Field. Led by Chef Ivan Gonzalez and Executive Chef Jared Porter, the menu celebrates beef and shellfish with world-class cuts and refined execution. Signature dishes include Dry Aged Prime Rib with fresh grated horseradish, the 32oz Porterhouse, and a Three-Pound Lobster Thermidor. The cocktail program is defined by precision, balance, and modern classicism, blending refined technique and classic inspiration. With polished service, warm lighting, and an atmosphere that feels instantly iconic, Cleaverman honors tradition while shaping the future of steakhouse dining in Phoenix.

name: Bacanora
description: Nestled in the heart of historic Grand Avenue, Bacanora defies tradition with its ambiance, intimacy, and flavors. Born from the visionary mind of James Beard award-winning Rene Andrade, Bacanora isn’t just a restaurant; but rather an experience. Rene and his team have shaped Bacanora into a haven for those seeking a taste of home and a warm hug with hospitality. Sticking to the roots of Sonoran cuisine, everything is carefully crafted over open flame y puro amor at Bacanora. If he’s up, then Phoenix is up!You may still experience a wait time upon arrival due to reservations being booked back-to-back at all tables. Please practice patience and understanding if this occurs because we are working as hard as possible to get everyone sat on time and to have a great experience.Parking can be found in the parking lot across McKinley from the restaurant, it is reserved for guests of Bragg’s and neighbors.

name: Lom Wong
description: Esquire | Best New Restaurants 2023 James Beard Winner | Best Chef Southwest 2025Phoenix New Times | Best Thai Restaurant 2023/2024 Lom Wong celebrates the diverse people and cultures of Thailand by cooking the types of food that one would find in villages and small towns across the different regions of the country. Additionally, we tell the stories of the amazing people who honored us teaching us their recipes. Our goal is to show another side of the cuisines of Thailand by being true to ingredients, techniques, and flavors. We hand-pound our curry paste, hand-squeeze coconut milk, and are sincere to the flavors Thailand. Additionally, we offer a fantastic natural wine list and cocktails that showcase unique Thai ingredients. Chefs: Yotaka and Alex Martin

name: Chilte
description: Bon Appétit's  | 24 Best New Restaurants in America 2023.We come from street beginnings, with off the cuff new wave riffs, and somewhat experimental Mexican cuisine. Finding common threads through food, time, and place we bringing inspirations from our childhoods, the southwest, and shared cultures to the plate.Inspired by tradition and driven with creative intention we are authentically us and genuinely yours - AlwaysChef Lawrence Smith

name: Course
description: Food Network ‘Chopped’ Champion Chef Cory Oppold and the culinary team take you on a food journey of both your taste and visual senses, using seasonality of products and a progression of flavor.COURSE offers an 8-course Chef tasting menu Friday and Saturday and a 5-course ‘choice of’ menu on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. A special menu series called, of • COURSE, is offered as "experiences" with limited reservation availability. Please contact us for large group dining and private events.Not just a meal, COURSE is a dining experience.MENU SCHEDULE- Our menus change seasonally; all menus can be viewed on our website- CourseRestaurantAZ.com SUMMER: 7/10/26- 9/23/26- Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday: 5-course - $135++- Friday & Saturday: 8-course - $175++

name: ELEVEN
description: Located in Pittsburgh’s Strip District, Eleven pays homage to the city’s history with its industrial backbone and polished interior. The Eleven culinary team crafts the ever-changing menu from the most vibrant seasonal products painstakingly sourced from farms across the region. Eleven’s offerings can be experienced in the well-appointed dining rooms or more casually at the bar with the Tavern menu. Every dish at Eleven places the ingredients at center stage, echoing the kitchen’s position in the heart of the building.Reservations are available up to 30 days in advance; we look forward to serving you!

name: Gi-Jin
description: Gi-Jin is a gin and raw bar that re-imagines the sushi experience where we marry global ingredients with traditional Japanese flavors to create inspired combinations of color, technique, and style.Our intimate space operates on a reservation-only basis for parties ofno more than FOUR (4) people per table and ONE/TWO per seating at our counter.Online reservations are always open with real-time availability.Each reservation seating is designated 2 hours per booking.We do not allow any outside alcohol. if you have a request for a specific beverage please email info@gijinpgh.com prior to your visit and we will try our best to bring it in!

name: Oma's Hideaway
description: Oma's Hideaway is a vibrant, maximalist restaurant inspired by the life and spirit of Chef Thomas Pisha Duffly's grandmother, Kiong Tien “Tina” Vandenberg. Her ability to adapt, to make the most out of limited resources, and to stay creative while projecting warmth and brightness is the guiding force behind Oma’s Hideaway.Born during the pandemic as a pop-up in the Gado Gado parking lot, Oma’s became a permanent beacon of iridescent light in Portland’s Richmond neighborhood in 2021. The menu draws from Tina’s life story, taking influence from the craveable, soul-satisfying hawker food of Singapore and Malaysia and “turning up the volume” with exaggerated yet balanced flavors in Chef Tom’s signature style. Oma’s serves dinner accompanied by a seasonal list of hand-crafted cocktails and zero-proof drinks.

name: Shalom Y'all
description: Shalom Y'all is an exploration and celebration of the Levant. We combines flavors and dishes from the Eastern Mediterranean, North Africa, and the Middle East with the produce and proteins of the Pacific Northwest to produce a phenomenal menu. Some standout items include the grilled lamb chops in Greek vinaigrette, the Baharat spiced chicken kebab served over mejadara, and our silky hummus served with fresh baked pita.Shalom Y'all is located in the heart of Eastside Portland, Oregon and boasts a charming, industrial atmosphere featuring exposed cement walls flanked by warm wooden accents. You'll experience innovative yet approachable cuisine, an inspired menu of cocktails and beverages, all in a lively atmosphere.We are currently reserving seating in our Dining Room, our Bar (21+), and our Chef's Counter.

name: Arden
description: Arden is an idyllic retreat tucked into Portland's Pearl District. Arden delivers seasonal Pacific Northwest cuisine and an award-winning wine program featuring over 250 bottles, many with bottle age. Guests have the option to dine a la carte or enjoy the chef's prix fixe menu ($75): a shared experience that features 4 courses of seasonal cuisine. Coursed wine pairings are also available ($50). Arden is named in homage to Shakespeare's famous forest - a place to escape the hustle and bustle of the city and appreciate nature's bounty and beauty. The restaurant invites you to take an exiting culinary adventure through the Pacific Northwest, and explore the incredible range of ingredients that the region has to offer.

name: Canard - Burnside
description: Wine bar meets casual eatery in the heart of Portland's Central East Side. From the team that brought you Le Pigeon.

name: L'Orange
description: Named one of the New York Times America's Best Restaurants 2024! Tucked away upstairs in a charming old storefront and voted one of Portland's 'Best New Restaurants' in 2023, L'Orange features an intimate dining space that beckons you to immerse yourself in a different era. Chef Joel Stocks and his talented team will guide your palate through adventurous dishes that blend European culinary traditions with the finest local ingredients. Experience the taste of "Old Portland" with every bite. Enhance your dining experience with a thoughtfully curated selection of wines, personally chosen by Owner/Winemaker Jeff Vejr and his team. While our wine list boasts a European focus, we also showcase a variety of local wines, including the exceptional offerings from Jeff's own Golden Cluster label. Join us at L'Orange for a taste of history, innovation, and the vibrant flavors of the Pacific Northwest!

name: Nodoguro
description: Nodoguro is a Japanese specialty restaurant in the heart of Portland. Your dinner follows the rhythms of kaiseki (Japan’s seasonal tasting tradition) reimagined through the ingredients and spirit of the Pacific Northwest. The meal unfolds slowly across 20 courses, from delicate vegetables and raw seafood to warm broths, steamed dishes, grilled bites, and a deeply flavorful rice and sushi courses.

name: Xiao Ye
description: Xiao Ye is a unique dining destination in Portland, Oregon, celebrated for its innovative approach to first-generation American cuisine. With a menu inspired by the rich flavors that define American dining today, Xiao Ye offers nostalgic comfort food with contemporary culinary techniques.At Xiao Ye, diners can enjoy a variety of dishes that reflect the diverse backgrounds and cultural influences from Chef Louis and his team. From hearty classics to creative twists, the menu is designed to appeal to a wide range of tastes. Their ever-changing menu allows for creativity and showcases seasonal produce of the PNW. Be sure to try their masa & mochiko Mini Madeleines!The candlelit, cozy interiors with mismatched chairs, makes it an ideal spot for gatherings, from a casual dinner with friends, a family dinner, or special celebration. Whether you're visiting for the first time or returning as a regular, you can expect a warm welcome and attentive service from the team lead by Jolyn Chen.

name: LangBaan
description: At Langbaan, classic Thai food is transformed into a refined five-course tasting menu using the bounty of Pacific Northwest ingredients.  We pride ourselves on providing a unique Thai-style dining experience inspired by century-old traditions here in Portland, Oregon. Our tasting menu changes seasonally, inspired by different regions of Thailand and the cultural history that surrounds the regions. Immersive, convivial, and intimate, the restaurant has only 33 seats and offers two seatings each night. We are hidden inside our sister restaurant, Phuket Cafe, on NW 23rd Place & Thurman.Reservations are released in one-month blocks. Bookings become available at noon on the 15th for the following month. (I.e., January reservations become available on the 15th of December.)

name: Hayward
description: Hayward offers “New Northwest” cuisine built on hyper-local, hyper-seasonal ingredients, transformed through fermentation, whole-animal butchery, and zero-waste practices. The ever-changing menu celebrates peak seasonality, creating dishes that feel both fresh and familiar.In Carlton, Oregon, the 70-seat dinner only restaurant opens Wednesday–Saturday at 4:30 pm, spread across six distinct spaces named like rooms in a home: sip on the Porch, circle the Bar’s brick fireplace, tuck into the Living Room’s cozy banquettes, gather in the main Dining Room, share the Kitchen’s communal banquette, or linger on the covered Garden patio.Chef/Owner Kari, who left Michelin kitchens in San Francisco to get closer to the source, has become a rising star in Oregon wine country. Hayward was a James Beard finalist for Best New Restaurant in 2024, and Kari followed as a semifinalist for Best Chef (NW & Pacific) in 2025.

name: Coquine
description: Located atop an extinct volcano in SE Portland’s Mt. Tabor neighborhood, Coquine Restaurant and Market sit side-by-side in a historic building.By day, the Market serves coffee, espresso, and freshly baked house-made pastries, alongside pantry supplies and home essentials. In the evening, it transforms into "Katy Jane's: An Oyster Bar!" where walk-ins are welcome from 5pm-8pm.The Dining Room is an inviting space where James Beard-nominated Chef Katy Millard cooks thoughtful, seasonal food. An award-winning wine program accompanies à la carte and prix fixe options. A five-course menu is available for guests with no restrictions; however, Coquine cannot guarantee a completely vegan menu.Dinner is served in both spaces. Reservations are recommended for the Dining Room (max party of 4). Coquine is a ZeroFoodPrint restaurant.Visit www.coquinepdx.com for current menus and hours. We look forward to serving you.

name: La Terrazza
description: La Terrazza, the newest addition to Umbria Hospitality Group, presents a delightful fusion of southern Italian and Mediterranean cuisine, complemented by an enchanting city skyline view. With seasonal delicacies, premium ingredients, and market-fresh produce, our menu showcases traditional favorites with innovative flair. Step into our inviting dining space adorned with floor-to-ceiling glass walls, or unwind at one of our two bars – one indoors and the other nestled in a patio enclosure. We aim to whisk you away to a culinary experience like no other. Patio seating is first come first serve for reservations.

name: Tamasha Modern Indian
description: ⭐ MICHELIN Guide 2025 | Esquire's Best New RestaurantExperience modern Indian dining at its finest at Tamasha Modern Indian in Raleigh’s North Hills. Owned by visionary entrepreneurs Mike Kathrani and Tina Vora, Tamasha offers an unparalleled culinary journey in a lavish space designed by Tina Vora. Executive Chef Bhavin Chhatwani, now Michelin-recognized and a 2025 James Beard Award semifinalist in the "Emerging Chef" category, leads the kitchen with a menu blending tradition and innovation. Celebrated as one of the “50 Most Beautiful Restaurants in America” by OpenTable and People Magazine. Tamasha is North Carolina’s only Indian restaurant to earn this Michelin recognition. With only 50 restaurants in the USA and around 200 worldwide honored, Tamasha is proud to be part of this elite culinary list.
